Tasks: Manual check-off Manual check-off
Certus Quartz
To get started with AE2, you will need to mine an important resource for the mod known as Certus Quartz. You will find Certus Quartz Crystals in Meteroites that you can mine for Certus Quartz Dust and Crystals.
Tasks: Certus Quartz Crystal Certus Quartz DustRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP

entries.name: Modular Routers

text.v: It all starts with the Router! So make one!
Also the Buffer is the single item slot in the Router where items will come and go through. And it will need Redstone signal for most modules to work.
Modules determine the action the Router preforms.
They can make it so your Router pulls items from Chests, or put items into chests, or even both! And much more!
Modules go into the Router themselves and multiple can be installed.
Filtering and Upgrades go into the Modules themselves.
Upgrades go directly into the Router and the Router can hold 5 of them. Upgrades directly affect all Modules that they can and usually can stack!
Augments are similar to Upgrades but for the individual Modules!
Sometimes a Router might be in a dangerous situation, like spawning a Wither.
In order to protect it you'll need a Blast Upgrade.
TNT won't break it, Wither won't break it, only you.
This upgrade makes the Router similar to a Framed Block.
Sneak Right Click a Block to change the Routers appearance to it.
Takes more Energy with the Energy Modules!
Fluid doesn't stack like Items do, so its upgrade is a little different. Still moves more just at a different rate.
Routers can be noisy, and noise definitely stacks when you have hundreds of them.
Might be nice to invest in Muffer Upgrades then!
Only you can use and mess with the Router after putting in the Upgrade.
A Router does it's action every time it has one of it's ticks.
This can be made to less Ticks with the Speed Upgrade!
Normally the Router moves 1 item each of it's Ticks. This can be doubled and stacked! with the Stack Upgrade.
1 Stack Upgrade is 2 Items, 2 Stacks 4 Items, and 6 Stacks is 64 Items a second.
This one is unique as it's not used for just 1 Router but for multiple.
If you want mutliple Routers working at the same time then each needs a Sync Upgrade.
Will need to be tuned in its own GUI.
Why wait? Usually items dropped in Minecraft have a second they need to hit the ground to be picked up again.
This upgrade lets the Vacuum Module not wait and immediately pick up the items.
We've seen Filters and we've seen Round Robins, now we're seeing both! This is useful for keeping the Items in a select order like for when making Mystical Agriculture Seeds!
Used with the Extruder MK2, blocks extruded will mimic the actual blocks. Redstone Blocks will emit Redstone, Glowstone will emit light, Grass will act transparent. But only with this Augment!
Doesn't work with Block Entities like Furnaces or Enrichment Chambers.
When moving items Routers can get pretty greedy, taking every single item they can get their grubby antennas on!
With Regulator Augment you can limit how much is moved.
Why wait? Oh you have valid reasons for waiting? Like items that might despawn. Huh wasn't thinking about those.
With Pickup Delay Augment the Vacuum Module will wait 10 ticks with every Augment in it to pick up dropped items!
The Extruder pushes blocks and entities by why not push it some more!
You don't want everything to do their actions at a larger range? You want your Vacuum to leave some room for dropping items in your World? Then I guess you can range down.
Just can't reach what you need to? Try Ranging Up!
With this everything will do their actions but farther. Vacuum has higher range for picking up items. Energy goes farther. Flinger flings with more strength!
Usually the Router commands the Modules but with this Augment the Module goes rouge! AWOl! Pure anarchy!
It will listen to it's own Redstone activation rather than the Routers.
Sometimes you don't want every Module to move multiple stacks at a time, so when you just want 1 Modules to do so use an Augment! This does not stack with Upgrades though... infact it overrides them.
Now even more like the Absorption Hopper!
Vacuum Module will now pickup XP Orbs as well as Items. Whatever you do with the XP is up to you!
Don't you hate Right Clicking everything? From Sheeps with Shears to Cows with Buckets? It's the 21st Century we should have Robots to everything! Or atleast Routers do everything.
With Activator Module it will act as if it were you Right Clicking things.
You can set what it will Right Click, if it will Attack or Use the Mob or Block, if you Shift Right Click, and how close they need to be in the Module.
Did you play around with the Placer too much and need to Break those Blocks?
Its Tier and Enchants are determined by the Pickaxe its Crafted with.
Now set the area and hopefully put a Filter and let it run!
Can be used with a Placer to do stuff like turning Ores into Items.
If you know how a Detector Rail works then this Module will be explanatory for you.
Basically if a certain Item is in the Router, it will emit a Redstone Signal out of the Router.
In the Module you can set the Item, where the Signal comes from, and how strong a Signal.

entries.name: Apothic Spawners

text.v: Another game change Apotheosis brings is to Spawners. Remember being able to mine Spawners with Silk Touch? Well it's back thanks to Apotheosis! There's also many new Modifications you can add to Spawners by right clicking any of these items.

Some mobs (mostly monsters) need certain Light Levels to spawn. Hostile ones needing lower levels and passive needing higher ones. Using a Soul Lantern makes it so you never have to worry about Light Levels as it ignores them! This does not ignore other requirements for spawning like livestock animals needing Grass.

A Fermented Spider's Eye can be used to increase the amount of mobs that CAN spawn from a spawner. The Mobs spawned is random with a Maximum amount determined by the number. It goes up or down by 1 for each eye to a maximum of 16.

Max entities is the amount of mobs that can be spawned by a spawner and kept. If it's only 6 max entities when 6 mobs are already spawned no more will spawned until they're dead or moved. Each Ghast Tear brings it up or down 2 Entities. Max of 16 Entities and Minimum of 1.

By using a Chorus Fruit on a Spawner you suck the souls out the mobs that will be spawned, only leaving a hollow husk of what they used to be. The mobs will lose all AI so they will do basically what an armor stand does. They can't hit you, can't teleport, can't move on their own. They sit there ready to be killed, how exciting!

This one might be new to ones returning from earlier versions. By using a turtle egg on a spawner, it will only spawn in baby versions of the mobs in it. This only works with Vanilla baby versions of mobs, not modded.
The Spawn Range is the area of where mobs can spawn. The bigger the area, the more room for them to spawn in. The smaller the area the cheaper the factory.
Redstone Activation gives your spawner an on/off switch. Without Redstone Power it will not spawn.
Activation Range is how close the Player (You) must be to the Spawner for it to work. The lowest it can be is 1 block away and the highest is a 48 block radius.

To determine when the Spawner will spawn it picks a random number between maximum and minimum spawn delay. The Minimum can be as low as 20 to as high as 32,767. Each piece of sugar modifies the min delay up or down by 10.

The Maximum Spawn Delay is how long it could take to spawn mobs. Just like the Minimum it can be as low as 20 to as high as 32,767. Each Clock modifies the speed of the spawner by 10. The speed is expressed in ticks where 20 ticks equals 1 second. So quickest spawn delay would be 1 second between each.
A Nether Star will do what the Prismarine Shards do but much better. Players no longer need to be near the spawner. As long as its chunk-loaded it will spawn.

The must-need for all Spawners. When it says ignores all conditions, it means most. Ignores light levels, blocks needing for spawning, and biomes. Space conditions are still needed though, like slimes needing 3x3 area to spawn, and same goes with players needing to be nearby.

The Quartz makes whatever the other item does, it does the opposite for the Spawner. With Quartz in your offhand and the other Spawner Modification item in your main it will do the opposite of its role. With Quartz and Blaze Rods instead of increasing Spawn Range it will decrease it. With Quartz and Ghast Tears it'll decrease Max Entities.

title.v: Quiet down you'll wake up the mobs!

text.v: Wool only does one thing to the spawner and that's to shut it up. Don't like hearing the stupid Spawner noises? Then use Wool! Any color, thread count, or design!
Echo shards give a special effect to the spawner. Any mobs spawned will have the loot that they drop multiplied.
Dripstone used on the spawner will reduce the max health of the mob spawned. This can decrease their health to as low as 20%
A Campfire used on the spawner will have the mobs spawn on fire. Perfect for a nice Steak.

entries.text:
Hostile Neural Networks
Welcome to Hostile Neural Networks!
Hostile Neural Networks (HNN for short) is a mod based around simulating mob kills for loot!
To do this, you will be collecting "data" on mobs, then running simulations from the data to create their drops!
Tasks: RedstoneRewards: 10 XP
Learning Mobs
The Learning HUD
The Deep Learner is one of the core components of HNN.
With this item, you can right click to open up a HUD and store Data Models to gather data while killing mobs.
Each Learner can hold 4 Data Models, and as long as you have the Learner anywhere in your inventory, it will collect data for the models placed inside!
Note: You can have multiple Deep Learners in your inventory, and it will count the kills for all Data Models inside all of the Learners.
Tasks: Deep LearnerRewards: 50 XP
Modeling Mobs
"Gathering Data"
Model Frameworks are the starting point for creating Data Models.
To start collecting data on a specific mob, you'll want to make one of these then right click the mob you'd like to gather data on. When done properly, the Model Framework will turn into the Data Model of the mob you clicked on.
To gather data for that mob, place the newly created Data Model inside of a Deep Learner, then start killing that specific mob with the Deep Learner in your inventory.
Tasks: Model FrameworkRewards: 50 XP
Simulating Deaths
The Simulation Chamber is the main machine within HNN.
When given power, it will run simulations based on the Data Model that is placed inside. The power required also depends on the Data Model placed inside, and can be seen within the Model's tooltip.
The machine also requires at least one Prediction Matrix to run a simulation.
The result of the simulation will be output onto the Matrix. Simulations will always produce some kind of Generalized Prediction, which can be used in various crafting recipes. They also vary depending on the origin of the mob in the Data Model.
If the simulation succeeds, you will receive a Mob Prediction based off of the model. The higher the tier of the Data Model used, the higher the success rate is for a simulation.
Tasks: Simulation Chamber Prediction MatrixRewards: 100 XP
Leveling Up Data Models
Once you make your first Data Model, you'll need to level it up to be useful.
Data Models start out at the first tier: Faulty. You'll need to at least level it to Basic if you'd like to run some simulations on it!
Once placed inside of the Deep Learner, the HUD will tell you how many kills are required to level it up. You can also see this info in the tooltip of the Model itself.
Tasks: %s Data ModelRewards: 50 XP

Makes various Overworld Materials

Creating Loot
The Loot Fabricator is the machine that gets you that sweet, sweet loot from Mob Predictions.
When given power and a successful Mob Prediction, you will be able to choose which item you'd like to get from that mob's Data Model. The machine will remember your choice, so it can be automated.

entries.text:
Mekanism: Reactors
Suiting Up for Reactors
Orange = Radiation Protection
To start our journey into the world of Mekanism Reactors, we'll start by making a Fission Reactor. These are multiblock structures that generate massive amounts of heat by burning Fissile Fuel. This reactor does not produce power on its own, but the heat generated can be used to heat Coolant to be used to generate power in an Industrial Turbine.
The Fission Reactor can be very dangerous, as a meltdown can cause an explosion as well as Radiation spreading over a 5 chunk radius, which lasts for several in-game weeks.
But we're going to be prepared for that. Let's make a Hazmat Suit, just in case... right?
Tasks: Hazmat Mask Hazmat Gown Hazmat Pants Hazmat BootsRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Fission Reactor Building Basics
Casings and Glass
It's time to gather the materials we'll need to build the reactor.
Just like most Mekanism multiblocks, reactors can be a custom size depending on your needs. They must be cuboid, with the minimum outside size being 3 wide, 4 tall, and 3 blocks deep. The maximum size is 18x18x18. We're going to build a 5x5 to start with.
The edges of the outer shell must be made out of Fission Reactor Casings, while the faces can be either casings or Reactor Glass, Reactor Ports, or Reactor Logic Adapters. We'll get to those later.
For now, let's build a basic 5x5x5 Fission Reactor!
Need more help building it? Holding w while hovering over the Fission Reactor Casing will show you the Ponder that can help you build it.
Tasks: Fission Reactor Casing ×44 Reactor Glass ×50Rewards: Loot 100 XP
Interacting with the Fission Reactor
For us to take anything in or out of the Fission Reactor, we'll need Fission Reactor Ports. These can be configured to input or output by using the Configurator.
Every Fission Reactor needs a minimum of 4 Ports:
- 1 Coolant Input - 1 Coolant Output - 1 Fissile Fuel Input - 1 Waste Output
For this starter build, let's put a port on each side like the image shown below. Make sure to configure them to match the list of inputs and outputs!
Tasks: Fission Reactor Port ×4Rewards: Loot 50 XP
Reactor Fail Safe
Because We've All Blown Up A Reactor Before
Afraid of blowing up your Fission Reactor and causing a massive Radiation leak? Don't worry, we all are. *insert terrible flashback here*
So how can we prevent such a catastrophic disaster? By creating a redstone Circuit Breaker using Fission Reactor Logic Adapters. Now these aren't 100% guaranteed to stop an explosion, but they are absolutely nice to have.
Essentially, these Adapters allow us to control the Reactor using Redstone. With just one, you can use a lever to turn on and off the reactor. However, we're going to use them for damage control.
You can also set these to give off a Redstone Signal based on a certain condition within the Reactor, like Damage Critical or Insufficient Fuel. This is useful for setting up a circuit breaker to shut off the Reactor if those ever happen.
Tasks: Fission Reactor Logic AdapterRewards: 50 XP
Inside the Reactor: Fuel Control
The inside of the reactor is built up of pillars using several Fission Fuel Assembly blocks, with a single Control Rod Assembly placed at the top of each pillar. These can be anywhere from 1 to 15 blocks in height, depending on the size of the reactor.
For this build, we'll put 2 of the Fission Fuel Assemblies in the center of our multiblock, and then put the Control Rod Assembly right on top of it.
Tasks: Fission Fuel Assembly ×2 Control Rod AssemblyRewards: Loot 50 XP
Example Circuit Breaker
Need a visual? Watch the Ponder!
Using some vanilla mechanics and 2 Fission Reactor Logic Adapters, we can create a simple circuit breaker to trip and turn off the reactor in case things get a little crazy.
To do this, we'll need a single piece of Redstone, a Piston, a block of either sand or gravel, and an Observer.
On one of the faces, we'll want to put a Logic Adapter down, then skip a block above it and then place another Adapter. Set the top Adapter to "Activation", and the bottom Adapter to "Damage Critical".
Next, in front and underneath the bottom Adapter, place any building block and stick a piece of Redstone on it leading from the Adapter. We'll then place a Piston facing up in front of that Redstone, then place our piece of sand or gravel on that Piston.
For the final part of our breaker, place the Observer with the face pointing outwards towards the Piston setup. This is important!
Whenever the Reactor has critical damage, it will then activate the bottom Adapter, causing the redstone to get a signal, which then activates the Piston and pushes up the Gravel/Sand. This will activate the Observer, which then turns off the Reactor.
Tasks: Fission Reactor Logic Adapter ×2 Redstone Any Gravels Piston ObserverRewards: Loot 50 XP
Cooling Our Reactor
High Quality H2O
When burning fuel, the Fission Reactor creates a massive amount of heat. To prevent the Reactor from converting into TNT, we need to make sure it is properly cooled.
The easiest way to do this is by giving the Reactor Water from a Sink. The Sink is an infinite water source, which is really nice for a situation like this.
Pump out the water into one of the Reactor's Ports that is set to input to fill up the Reactor with water. This will be heated while the Reactor is running and get converted to Steam, which you can use to create power within an Industrial Turbine.
Sodium can also be used as a much more efficient coolant. This allows for higher burn rates and lower core temperatures.
Tasks: SinkRewards: Loot 10 XP
The Fission Reactor Interface
Those are definitely numbers
Once you've finished placing in all of the required blocks to build the Reactor, it should give off red particles to show that it is complete.
Right clicking anywhere on the Reactor will open up the Interface. This will have all of the information you need to run the Reactor properly, as well as two buttons to turn on and off the Reactor.
On the left, you have 2 tanks: One for Coolant and one for Fissile Fuel. On the right, you have one for Nuclear Waste, and one for Heated Coolant, which will most likely be Steam.
The Temperature bar will show you how hot the Reactor is. After a certain temp, the Reactor will start taking Damage, which will eventually cause the Reactor to explode.
To adjust the Burn Rate of the Fissile Fuel and see more statistics, click on the (I) tab on the left side. Here, you can adjust the Rate Limit, which controls how much fuel the Reactor burns per tick.
Tasks: Manual check-offRewards: Loot 250 XP
Uranium
Of Course It Uses Uranium
Every Reactor uses Uranium somewhere for fuel, right?
For starters, let's gather some Uranium Ingots. We'll need to process these in an Enrichment Chamber to turn it into Yellow Cake Uranium.
Tasks: Yellow Cake Uranium ×2Rewards: Loot 25 XP
Uranium Oxide
Once we have our hands on Yellow Cake Uranium, we can send it through a Chemical Oxidizer to create the gas, Uranium Oxide.
Tasks: Chemical OxidizerRewards: Loot 25 XP
Mekanism: Reactors
In this chapter, we'll be using advanced Mekanism machines to create powerful multiblock Reactors, as well as advanced ways to create and store power. This will also lead to making Antimatter Pellets, which are used to make the ATM Star, as well as some of the strongest tools and weapons in the pack.
Tasks: Chemical CrystallizerRewards: 50 XP
Quest
The Fission Reactor needs Fissile Fuel to run. If you look up Fissile Fuel right now in JEI, I bet you'll get overwhelmed with everything you need to make it. It's okay, you've got this. Let's take it one step at a time.
It all boils down to creating Uranium Hexafluoride. To do this, let's focus on making these two gases: Hydrofluoric Acid, and Uranium Oxide.
Tasks: Manual check-offRewards: 100 XP
Sulfuric Acid
A Quick Recap
You should have already made Sulfuric Acid for your Tier 4 Ore Processing facility, but here is a reminder on how to get it.
Start by getting Sulfur by finding it underground, or by mixing Hydrogen Chloride with Gunpowder in a Chemical Injection Chamber.
Take the Sulfur Dust and run it through a Chemical Oxidizer to get Sulfur Dioxide. Combine that with Oxygen in a Chemical Infuser to get Sulfur Trioxide.
Next, we'll combine Water Vapor with the Sulfur Trioxide to make Sulfuric Acid.
Tasks: SulfurRewards: Loot 25 XP
Hydrofluoric Acid
Let's take our Sulfuric Acid and combine it with Fluorite in a Chemical Dissolution Chamber to make Hydrofluoric Acid.
We're almost there!
Tasks: Fluorite Chemical Dissolution ChamberRewards: Random loot roll 25 XP
Uranium Hexafluoride
Using another Chemical Infuser, we want to combine our Hydrofluoric Acid with Uranium Oxide to make Uranium Hexafluoride.
Tasks: Chemical InfuserRewards: Loot 50 XP
Fissile Fuel
Once we have an Isotopic Centrifuge, we can run our Uranium Hexafluoride in and create Fissile Fuel!
See, that wasn't so bad was it?
Tasks: Isotopic CentrifugeRewards: Loot 100 XP
Quest
Let's go through the checklist one more time to ensure we have everything ready to go before we boot it up:
1. Hazmat Suit on (safety first). 2. Water/coolant pumping into an input Port. 3. Fissile Fuel pumping into an input Port. 4. A Port set to output the Heated Coolant, either to a trashcan or an Industrial Turbine. 5. A Port set to output Nuclear Waste leading to Radioactive Waste Barrels or machines to process it, or both!
If you're ready to go, hit that Activate button! You can also adjust the Burn Rate to produce more Nuclear Waste, but start slow.
Tasks: Manual check-offRewards: 50 XP
Dealing with Nuclear Waste
Once we start burning up Fissile Fuel in the reactor, we'll get heated Coolant and Nuclear Waste.
This is where the Radiation kicks in. As long as it stays safely in some container or machine, you won't have any spills....right?
The best way to store any Radioactive substance is using a Radioactive Waste Barrel. These will safely store the waste, while slowly decaying the gas without causing a Radiation spill. You don't want your Nuclear Waste sitting in your Reactor as it causes it to produce more heat, so set a port to output Waste and ship it to a barrel!
Important Note: Breaking any machine, barrel, pipe, or anything that has a Radioactive gas inside of it will cause a Radiation leak. That includes the products of Nuclear Waste, like Polonium or Plutonium.
Tasks: Radioactive Waste Barrel ×3Rewards: Loot 50 XP
Plutonium Pellet
Nuclear Waste can be sent into an Isotopic Centrifuge to create Plutonium.
Sending the Plutonium into a Pressurized Reaction Chamber with some water and Fluorite Dust will give you Plutonium Pellets. These are used to make end game materials!
Note: This will also create a byproduct of Spent Nuclear Waste, which needs to be pumped into a Waste Barrel for storage.
Tasks: Plutonium PelletRewards: Loot 100 XP
Polonium Pellet
Pumping Nuclear Waste into a Solar Neutron Activator will give you Polonium.
Run the Polonium through a Pressurized Reaction Chamber with some Fluorite Dust and you'll get Polonium Pellets. You will need a good bit of these for the future.
Note: This will also create a byproduct of Spent Nuclear Waste, which needs to be pumped into a Waste Barrel for storage.
Tasks: Polonium PelletRewards: Loot 100 XP
Supercritical Phase Shifter
The Supercritical Phase Shifter (SPS for short) is another multiblock structure used to infuse Polonium with large amounts of power to create Antimatter gas, which can be crystallized into pellets.
To build the SPS, you'll need to make a total of 72 SPS Casings (60 for the build, 12 to make the ports), 3 SPS Ports, 122 Reactor Glass, and one other item we'll talk about in the next quest. Let's get the materials first!
Tasks: SPS Casing ×60 Reactor Glass ×64 Reactor Glass ×58 SPS Port ×3Rewards: SPS Port Loot 100 XP
The Fusion Reactor
The Best Power Source in the Pack
You might have heard people talk about how the Fusion Reactor is the best power source in the pack. Well, they might be right
Once activated, the Reactor can push out up to 80MRF/t with the right setup. It can also be cooled with water to produce steam, which can go into an Industrial Turbine to make even more power.
To build the Fusion Reactor, we need to follow a simple pattern. Each face will look like this:
For the ports, you can replace any of the Reactor Glass on the sides. For this setup, we'll need two ports to input Deuterium and Tritium, then a port to output power.
Tasks: Fusion Reactor Controller Fusion Reactor Frame ×36 Fusion Reactor Port ×3 Reactor Glass ×25Rewards: Loot 100 XP
Supercharged Coils
Supercharged Coils are placed on an SPS Port in the center of two faces, like the image below. When given power, these will supercharge Polonium into Antimatter. Only 1 is required, but you can use 2 if you want.
To produce 1mb of Antimatter, you need 40MRF. If you haven't started making a Fusion Reactor, now's a good time to make it!
Tasks: Supercharged CoilRewards: Supercharged Coil Loot 100 XP
Quest
With all of the gathered blocks, it's time to build this thing. Below is a text guide, or you can watch the Ponder!
The SPS will be 7x7 when built, but it isn't a cube. It follows a simple pattern, which you can follow the images below as a build guide. The pattern looks like this:
Each side, including the bottom and top, will follow this pattern. The Supercharged Coils should be placed across from each other in the center of their respective sides, and the remaining two ports will be used to pump in Polonium, and pump out Antimatter Gas. Here is the completed structure below:
Tasks: Manual check-offRewards: Loot 100 XP
Antimatter Pellet
After zapping away trillions of power in the SPS, we can finally create Antimatter Pellets.
Run the Antimatter Gas you get from the SPS into a Chemical Crystallizer and you'll get 1 Antimatter Pellet for every 1,000mb you make.
Tasks: Antimatter PelletRewards: Loot 1000 XP
Jumpstarting Method: Laser Focus Array
To see a visual, check out the Ponder by holding W while hovering over the Laser Focus Matrix.
The goal is to aim each Laser into a Laser Amplifier. Using one is pretty slow, so we're going to make a few.
In the image below, you can see an example of how this is set up. Sticking the Lasers directly on a power source like an Energy Cube works, or you can have them on pipes or cables. You want to give it a block of empty space between the lasers and the Laser Amplifier.
The Laser Amplifier has a red dot on one of the faces. This is what you want to point towards the Laser Focus Matrix.
Make sure to turn the Laser Amplifier off (or activate Redstone control) and wait for it to store at least 400MRF, then it'll be ready.
Tasks: Laser Amplifier Laser ×3Rewards: Loot 100 XP
Fueling the Fusion Reactor: Tritium
By now, you're already making Lithium. Pump that into a Solar Neutron Activator to create Tritium.
Tasks: Solar Neutron ActivatorRewards: Loot 50 XP
Fueling the Reactor: Deuterium
To fuel our Fusion Reactor, we'll need to create two different gases, this one being Deuterium.
To make this, we'll need to make some Electric Pumps and give them a Filter Upgrade. Place them over a source block of water, give them some power, and they'll pump out Heavy Water.
Pump the Heavy Water into an Electrolytic Separator to get Deuterium.
Tasks: Electric Pump Filter UpgradeRewards: Loot 50 XP
The Fuel Injector
To kick start the Fusion Reactor, we'll need a quick shot of D-T fuel. This is made by combining Deuterium and Tritium together in a Chemical Infuser.
Start by making a Hohlraum and place it into the Infuser (where the plus symbol is) to fill it with D-T fuel. Now we're ready to jumpstart the Reactor!
Tasks: HohlraumRewards: Loot 100 XP
Laser Focus
Frickin' Laser Beams
To create a reaction for the Reactor to turn on, we're going to need to inject it with a ton of power. And I mean a ton of power.
This requires you to set up several Lasers that all need to be powered, then shooting 400MFE directly into the Laser Focus Matrix.
The Laser Focus Matrix is placed in the center of one face of the Fusion Reactor. We'll build the Lasers next.
Tasks: Laser Focus MatrixRewards: Loot 100 XP
Fueling the Fusion Reactor
Fusion Reactors require a very special fuel: D-T Fuel to be exact.
There are two ways to fuel the Reactor: Either by pumping in D-T Fuel directly into the Reactor at 1,000mb/t, or by pumping each of the two fuels in separately at controlled rates.
For starters, let's pump them in separately. We probably need to know how to make them as well.
Tasks: Manual check-offRewards: 10 XP
I Think We're Ready
Hohlraum filled with D-T Fuel? Check!
Deuterium and Tritium ready to be pumped into the Reactor? Check!
A Laser Amplifier with at least 400MRF ready to shoot into the Laser Focus Matrix? Check!
Once you are ready, place the Hohlraum into the Fusion Reactor Controller, pump in the Fuel, then activate your Laser Amplifier.
If done right, you'll see the Reactor activate!
Tasks: HohlraumRewards: Loot 500 XP
The End Game Power Source
The Fusion Reactor can produce up to 200MRF/t on its own, but first we need to understand some mechanics.
The easiest way to produce power is by pumping in Deuterium and Tritium separately, then controlling how much fuel is burned using the Injection Rate in the Fuel Tab.
This has to be an even number with a max of 98, as it combines the D-T fuel inside of the Reactor itself. The consumption of each fuel is equal to half of the Injection Rate per tick, meaning 49mb/t of each for the max.
However, you can directly inject D-T Fuel, but will not be able to control the Injection Rate. This will create massive amounts of power per tick, but at a much higher fuel consumption rate of 500mb/t of each fuel.
Tasks: Forge EnergyRewards: Ultimate Induction Cell Loot 500 XP
The Industrial Turbine
Building the Frame
The Industrial Turbine is a massive multiblock structure used to convert Heated Coolant into power. The minimum size is 5x5x5, with the maximum size being 17x17x18.
To build the Turbine, we'll need several blocks so let's start with the basics.
Just like most Mekanism multiblocks, the frame must be made out of Turbine Casings. However, instead of Reactor Glass, you can use Structural Glass or Casings for each face.
We're going to build this Turbine, and the quest requires the exact materials needed.
Tasks: Turbine Casing ×52 Structural Glass ×52Rewards: Loot 100 XP
The Ports
Turbine Valves are used to pump in Steam, as well as pumping out the power that the Turbine creates.
Turbine Vents are used to pump out excess water when using Saturating Condensers. Otherwise, these help increase the overall flow of steam within the Turbine. The total number of Vents also limits the total Steam Flow Rate. Vents can also be used on the top face of the Turbine, but for this build, we'll just be using them on the outside faces.
Saturating Condensers are used to convert Steam back into water. These are placed on or above the layer containing the Electromagnetic Coils.
Tasks: Turbine Valve ×2 Turbine Vent ×24 Saturating Condenser ×8Rewards: Loot 50 XP
The Rotor
The Turbine Rotor is placed in the middle of the Turbine. For every Turbine Rotor, you will need 2 Turbine Blades. For this Turbine, we'll be using 3 Rotors.
While looking at the Rotor, right clicking with Turbine Blades will place them directly onto the Rotor. The taller the Rotor, the longer the Blades will become. For this build, we are using 6 total Blades. If you plan on building a bigger Turbine, you will need to increase the width of the Turbine depending on how many Blades you plan on using.
The Rotational Complex must be placed at the top of the Turbine Rotor. This is then surrounded by Pressure Dispersers.
The Dispersers must fill out the entire layer where the Rotational Complex sits.
Tasks: Turbine Rotor ×3 Rotational Complex Pressure Disperser ×8 Turbine Blade ×6Rewards: Loot 50 XP
Electromagnetic Coil
The Electromagnetic Coil is placed directly on top of the Rotational Complex to convert the kinetic energy into power.
You can use multiple, with 7 being the max with a Turbine using 28 blades. These must either touch another Coil, or the Rotational Complex.
Tasks: Electromagnetic CoilRewards: Loot 50 XP
Creating Power with the Turbine!
If you've built the Turbine properly, you will see red particles around the structure. Right clicking on the Turbine will open up the interface.
This will tell you all of the information that you need to know, including the total Steam Flow Rate, as well as the total Steam inside of the Turbine.
On the right, you will have a bar that shows you the Power that is stored inside of the Turbine. If this gets full, the Turbine will turn off, unless you set it to Vent Overflow.
Let's get it running!
Once you have a fully functioning Fission Reactor, pump out the Steam directly into a Turbine Valve on your Turbine. Since we're using Saturating Condensers in this build, you can pump out water from a Turbine Vent back into your Reactor if you want.
Tasks: Manual check-offRewards: Loot 250 XP
Advanced Power Storage
If we want to create massive amounts of power, we'll need a way to store all of it, and those Energy Cubes just won't cut it.
We're going to create a customizable multiblock used to store large amounts of power, but first, we need to make some Lithium Dust!
You should have some Brine being made from a previous quest using the Thermal Evaporation Plants. Run the Brine through another Thermal Evaporation Plant to get Liquid Lithium, then use a Rotary Condensentrator to get Lithium which you can run through a Chemical Crystallizer to get Lithium Dust.
Tasks: Lithium DustRewards: Loot 100 XP
Building the Induction Matrix
The Energy Cube's Papa
Almost every Mekanism multiblock is built the same way.
You'll need to make a rectangular prism structure. The edges must be made out of Induction Casings. The faces can be made of either Casings, Structural Glass, or Induction Ports. It's best to have 2 Ports: one for input, and one for output. These can be changed using the Configurator.
For this build, we'll be making a 5x5x5. This quest requires the exact amount of materials needed to build this.
Tasks: Induction Casing ×44 Induction Port ×2 Structural Glass ×55Rewards: Loot 100 XP
Customizing Our Power Limits
The Induction Matrix allows you to customize how much power you can store and transfer by adding Cells and Providers inside of the multiblock structure.
Induction Cells increase the total amount of power that can be stored.
Induction Providers increase the total transfer speed both in and out of the Matrix.
You can customize how many you want of each inside of the multiblock, but you will need at least one of each. These also have higher tiers to increase your overall storage and transfer capacity.
Tasks: Smart Filter Smart FilterRewards: Loot 100 XP
Completing the Matrix
Once you've finished building your first Energized Induction Matrix, you'll see red particles all around the structure to show that it is complete.
Don't be afraid to upgrade with higher tier Cells and Providers! Need more space for them? The maximum size the Induction Matrix can be is 18x18x18.
Tasks: Induction PortRewards: Loot 100 XP

text.v: This series of mods is mostly dedicated to XyCraft: World and Machines!
World gives us the Gems which can be found while mining.
The B in Roy G. Biv
The R in Roy G. Biv
Kivi can be used for a couple of things, mainly for decorations and machines.
You'll need Kivi for Machine Frames and other machines in XyCraft. It can be used with Xychorium Gems in a Stonecutter for decorative blocks.
Reinforce the Kivi with Aluminum and you'll get Machine Frames which are needed to craft machines.
spawns fire infront of it when given a Redstone Signal.
It will put out the fire when the Signal is stopped.
works similar to normal Farmland but with some changes.
It's automatIically watered and it's faster than normal Farmland.
acts as Water without the whole moving part.
Cobble Gens can be made with them, Farmland can be watered with it, you just can't MLG clutch with it. (Fish will also try to get into it but will still die).
The Light Field doesn't show much light, but it does work like a Mega Torch.
Mobs won't spawn in a set area around it. That area is about a 32 block radius.
is a block that stops all water connected to it.
Source blocks or flowing water, anything within a 1 block radius is gone.
The Extrator will "grow" the block or item beneath it and move it to an inventory above it.
This can be used for a Cobblestone generator that works with many types of stone, an Amethyst generator, or even a Dragon Egg generator, along with others!
The Balloon on a Stick is an early and restrictive source of Creative Flight.
Place down the stick and you'll be attached to a balloon! Double touch space to start Flying just not too far. Go too far and you'll get detached and fall.

entries.text:
Basic Power
Basic Power
All The Power!
This chapter is dedicated to all things power related!
Here you'll find the basic ways to generate, store, and transfer power.
Tasks: RedstoneRewards: 10 XP
Mekanism: Renewable Energy
The Power of the Sun...
Mekanism provides several ways to make power using renewable resources.
The Solar Generators harness the power of the Sun to provide basic power needs. It does not work during the night, and must have access to the sky. Glass is okay.
The Wind Generator provides power via the wind. Unless you've figured out a way for your character to manually spin this, the speed it spins is based off of the Y lvl it is placed at. It also needs direct access to the sky without any blocks above it.
Tasks: Smart FilterRewards: Random loot roll 50 XP
Heat Generator
Mekanism's Heat Generator is a different take on basic power production. It has two modes of creating power:
Passive: Surrounding the generator with Lava source or flowing blocks creates passive power over time through heat. Place one Lava source block on top and let it flow over the sides. Make sure to have Pipes connected for energy first!
Active: Placing combustible materials such as Coal or Wood into the generator will burn the fuel to create power. This is not very efficient.
Tasks: Heat GeneratorRewards: Random loot roll 50 XP
Early Game Power Options
Starter Power
Looking for early game power options? These are good ways to get you started with generating power.
These don't produce a ton of power, but they are typically easy or cheap to get in the early game!
Tasks: CoalRewards: 10 XP
Mekanism: Universal Cables
Mekanism's Energy Transfer Pipe
Mekanism offers a nice looking Cable to transfer your power.
If the machine you are connecting to already pulls or pushes power, you will not need to configure the Cable. Otherwise, you'll need a Configurator to configure the Cable. Shift right-clicking will change the Cable to pull or push mode.
Tasks: Smart FilterRewards: Infused Alloy 50 XP
Transferring Power
If you're looking for different ways to get power out of your machines, this is where you can find it!
There are several options, both wired and wireless, for transferring power.
Tasks: Iron IngotRewards: 10 XP
Mekanism: Quantum Entangloporter
Doesn't just work for Power
With a little work into Mekanism, this machine allows you to transfer anything wirelessly.
You can set specific channels to transfer individual items, energy, or even gases from Mekanism. It's pretty cool.
Tasks: Quantum EntangloporterRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Storing Power
This section shows you different ways to store your power!
Tasks: Iron IngotRewards: 10 XP
Mekanism: Energy Cubes
Mekanism is one of the best mods for energy storage, especially in the early game.
The Basic Energy Cube is easy to configure, easy to craft, and stores a lot of power. It can also be upgraded, and can charge items inside of the interface!
To learn more about upgrading the Energy Cube as well as the mod, head over to the Mekanism quest chapter!
Tasks: Smart FilterRewards: Steel Casing 50 XP
Mid Game Power Options
You can't power your base off of Coal forever! If you've got a decent amount of resources available, it's time to upgrade your power setup!
These options usually require a little setting up, but produce enough power to carry you far into your playthrough.
Tasks: DiamondRewards: 10 XP
Mekanism: Gas-Burning Generator
MELON POWER!
If you've ever heard of someone talking about "Melon Power", this is it. Mekanism's Gas-Burning Generator can produce a good amount of power by pumping in Ethylene made from Melon Slices.
To produce Ethylene, start by crushing organic materials in a Crusher to create Bio Fuel. Melon Slices are typically used for this! This is then pumped into a Pressurized Reaction Chamber (PRC for short).
The PRC needs Water, Bio Fuel, and some Hydrogen to create Ethylene. You can get the Hydrogen from separating water in an Electrolytic Separator.
Once you've started producing the Ethylene, pump it into the Gas-Burning Generator to start generating power!
Tasks: Gas-Burning GeneratorRewards: Melon Slice ×8 Random loot roll
More Powah!
Believe it or not, the Powah mod has some great options for getting... powwe.
Make sure to check out the Powah qyest chapter to learn more!
Tasks: UraniniteRewards: 10 XP
End Game Power Options
More Power Than You'll Need
If you're looking to generate a ton of power, you can start by scaling up some of the options from the Mid Game Power section. Make your Reactors bigger. Upgrade your Thermo Generators to Nitro. Go wild.
However, you may need even more power.
Tasks: Netherite IngotRewards: 10 XP
More Power Storage
Mekanism's Induction Matrix is the ultimate way to store your power.
If you're looking for the best power storage in the game, check out the Mekanism: Reactors quest chapter.
Tasks: Smart Filter Smart FilterRewards: 10 XP
Flux Networks
The Ultimate Wireless Power Solution
Flux Networks is a mod that aims to be the solution to all of your wireless power needs.
The mod itself does not have a way to generate power, but it can store and wirelessly transmit power, even across dimensions. It can even charge your items in your inventory.
You can even charge your Jetpacks while you are flying with this mod.
To get started with the mod, you'll need some Flux Dust. Head to Bedrock, then throw some Redstone on top of some Bedrock. Place some Obsidian right above the floating Redstone, then left click the Obsidian.
Tasks: Flux Dust ×4Rewards: Flux Dust ×2 50 XP
The "Core" Crafting Materials
Of Cores you need these
In this mod, you'll need Flux Cores and Flux Blocks to craft the core parts of your network. Make a few of each!
Tasks: Flux Core ×4 Flux BlockRewards: Flux Dust ×4 100 XP
Starting Your Network
Just plug it in!
The first item you'll need to start your Flux Network is a Flux Plug.
The Plug is used to "draw" power from the block it is attached to. Aside from a small buffer, the Plug does not store any power itself, so don't worry about it zapping up all of your power.
It is suggested to place the Plug on a power storage block like an Energy Cube. It can connect to Cables, Pipes, or the output of any power producing machine.
To learn how to set up your first network, check the next quest!
Tasks: Flux PlugRewards: Flux Block 100 XP
Quest
Becoming a Network Admin!
If you right-click on the Plug, you'll see the Flux Network UI. On the far top-right corner, click on the + button to create your first network. You'll need to set a password to create the network, but you can also set a color!
From here, you can go to the Network Selection tab to activate your network on the Plug. If the Plug is attached to a power source, you can now harness that power anywhere in your system using a Flux Point!
Pro Tip: You can create multiple networks if you want to have different power sources powering different parts of your systems!
Tasks: Manual check-offRewards: Flux Dust ×2 50 XP
Accessing Network Power
With our Plug set up, we can now tap into the power from our network. The Flux Point does exactly that. It points the power from your network to whatever block it is attached to, including Pipes or Cables, or just directly on machines!
Once you've placed your Point on the machine or block you want to power, right-click on it and select your network in the "Network Selection" tab. Just like the Plug, you can adjust how much power the Point pulls, priority level, etc.
Tasks: Flux PointRewards: Flux Core ×2 100 XP
Flux Storage
Storing Power
Flux Networks does provide a way to store the power you generate for your network!
These hold massive amounts of power overall, and can be upgraded to store even more!
Tasks: Basic Flux StorageRewards: Flux Block ×2 100 XP
Quest
Right clicking a functional Flux Network block will give you this UI.
Each Plug or Point can be named, have a custom priority level, and have a custom power transfer limit. This allows complete control over all parts of your system.
Bypass Limit ignores the limit set.
There are several other tabs to check out, mostly for statistics on your network!
Tasks: Manual check-offRewards: Flux Dust 10 XP
Wireless Charging
Flux Networks also provides a way to charge your items wirelessly, even across dimensions!
Once you have a Plug attached to your power system, you'll want to make the Flux Controller and place it down.
Right-click on it to bring up the interface, and go to the "Wireless Charging" tab. From there, you can select each section of your inventory you'd like to keep charged. To activate, make sure to hit the toggle button at the bottom to enable Wireless Charging, then click apply!
Tasks: Flux ControllerRewards: Flux Block 100 XP
Industrial Foregoing: Mycelial Reactor
It's not Yourcelial Reactor
The Mycelial Reactor consists of all the Mycelial Generators working at the same time, near the reactor block, and it produces a total of 25MFE/t.
All sounds good, but you need to automate some stuff to get it working, see what each Mycelial Generator consumes to work, and automate it, most things are simple, but others, not that much... looking at Disenchanting Mycelial Generator.
But after you get it all automated, you don't need to stop at one, you can make more reactors.
Tasks: Mycelial ReactorRewards: Supreme Machine Frame 100 XP
Mekanism: Fusion Reactor
Fusion Activate!
Mekanism has an end game power option that is tough to beat. The Fusion Reactor can produce up to 80MRF/t, and if you want to learn how to build it, make sure to check out the Mekanism: Reactors quest chapter!
Tasks: Fusion Reactor ControllerRewards: Ultimate Control Circuit ×2 100 XP

Mycelial Reactor, huh?
The Mycelial Reactor consists of all the Mycelial Generators working at the same time, near the reactor block, and it produces a total of 25MFE/t.
All sounds good, but you need to automate some stuff to get it working, see what each Mycelial Generator consumes to work, and automate it, most things are simple, but others, not that much... looking at Disenchanting Mycelial Generator.

Ether Gas? Huh?
Getting your first Ether Gas might be a little bit scary.
Ether Gas is made from drilling a Wither, using a Fluid Drill with a Purple Lens.
But don't worry about the Wither, Industrial Foregoing has a machine just to help you with that task. The Stasis Chamber is a machine that freezes in place anything that is on top of it in a 3x3 area, including the Wither.
Hope you don't run out of power, because if you do... I hope you're ready to fight the Wither.

Now about making Plastic: Plastic results from smelting Dry Rubber - which is made in the Latex Processing Unit, that transforms Latex into Dry Rubber.
So basically Latex -> Dry Rubber -> Plastic.

Generators N Furnaces
Iron Furnace
Iron Furnaces (Don't be confused with each of the titles with Iron Furnaces being the mod name and an Item name) work even faster than Normal and Copper Furnaces. They take 160 Ticks to work, or 8 seconds.
These can be crafted from either a normal Furnace or Copper Furnace! And they can be made into either a Silver Furnace or Gold Furnace.
Tasks: Iron FurnaceRewards: Stone to Iron Furnace Upgrade Coal Block ×2
Golden Furnace
The Gold Furnace is better than the Iron ones with a Cooktime of 120 Ticks.
It can be crafted with Silver or Iron Furnace and is crafted into a Diamond one!
Tasks: Golden FurnaceRewards: Silver to Gold Furnace Upgrade Iron to Gold Furnace Upgrade Coal Block ×3
Diamond Furnace
Diamonds the staple of Minecraft, and of upgraded Furnaces apparently... These work even faster only taking 80 Ticks or 4 Seconds to smelt items. That's even faster than a Blast Furnace! These are only crafted by Gold Furnaces and can be crafted into Crystal or Emerald Furnaces.
Tasks: Diamond FurnaceRewards: Gold to Diamond Furnace Upgrade Coal Block ×4
Emerald Furnace
The Emerald Furnace, I wonder if Villagers will trade for it? It works at 40 Ticks or only 2 Seconds to smelt! Blink and you might miss it. These are crafted by Diamond Furnace and can be made into an Obsidian Furnace.
Tasks: Emerald FurnaceRewards: Diamond to Emerald Furnace Upgrade Coal Block ×5
Obsidian Furnace
It may be Obsidian but don't worry you don't need a Diamond Pickaxe to pick it up, just to craft it.
It works every 20 Ticks or every Second. Yeah not Seconds just Second.
It can be crafted with a Crystal Furnace or Emerald Furnace, and can be crafted into a Netherite Furnace!
Tasks: Obsidian FurnaceRewards: Crystal to Obsidian Furnace Upgrade Coal Block ×6
Crystal Furnace
If Emeralds aren't your thing the Crystal Furnace might be what you want! Works the same as an Emerald Furnace at 40 Tick. Made with a Diamond Furnace and can be made into an Obsidian Furnace. (No you can't see the Items smelting inside it, it's just transparent)
Tasks: Crystal FurnaceRewards: Diamond to Crystal Furnace Upgrade Coal Block ×5
Copper Furnace
Copper is one if not the most common Ore you can find, so why not use a bunch of spare Copper to upgrade your furnace!
Normal Furnaces take 200 Ticks to smelt 1 Item, (20 Ticks = 1 Second) while Copper Furnaces take 180 Ticks.
They can be crafted into either Silver or Iron Furnaces.
Tasks: Copper FurnaceRewards: Stone to Copper Furnace Upgrade Coal Block
Silver Furnace
Following the same pattern, these ones smelt at 140 Ticks or 7 Seconds.
They can be crafted with Copper or Iron Furnaces and can be used to craft a Gold Furnace.
Tasks: Silver FurnaceRewards: Copper to Silver Furnace Upgrade Copper to Iron Furnace Upgrade Coal Block ×2
Rainbow Furnace
The Rainbow Furnace needs quite literally every other Furnace to Craft. 8 Rainbow Plating and 1 Rainbow Core gives us the best Furnace we could imagine!
Yes it takes 20 Ticks to smelt or 1 Second to smelt, but it doesn't smelt 1 item. How many items you ask? How many are in a stack of items?

text.v: The Metallurgic Infuser is used to craft core crafting components throughout Mekanism.
The machine works by infusing a material (middle-left slot) with an "infuser" (far-left slot).
This is also how you get Steel Ingots.
This machine works like a Macerator or Pulverizer, and will break ores down into dusts.
This breaks 3 raw ores down into 4 dusts.
This is the start of your Ore Factory. It can also be upgraded to a factory machine, increasing the slots of use.
The machine creates two really strong ingots: Refined Glowstone and Refined Obsidian.
It infuses an item with Osmium to create a more powerful ingot.

This machine crushes ores into their "dirty dust" forms. This is useful to convert clumps into dirty dust, which can go through an Enrichment Chamber to create the ore dust, which then can be smelted into an ingot.
This machine can mine for you!
It is completely configurable, and can even replace mined blocks with cobblestone, or whatever block you provide it with!
It has a bucket mode which can be toggled to scoop up liquids with it. Very useful for lava in the beginning!
A Mini-Robot To Accompany You On Your Travels
This item upgrades a base machine to a Basic Factory machine.
This item is how you make Wireless Transfers possible.
You can set specific channels, named by you, to transfer whatever you want from it.
This block stores power, and can also be used to charge items.

Infusing Osmium with Redstone in a Metallurgic Infuser will create you one of these.
Infusing Iron with Coal or Charcoal in a Metallurgic Infuser will give you Enriched Iron.
Infusing the Enriched Iron with more Coal or Charcoal will give you Steel Dust, which can be smelted into Steel.
This is a major crafting component in a lot of recipes in Mekanism.

This machine "Purifies" our ores. It turns 1 Raw Ore into 2 "Clumps", which can then be sent through a Crusher to be turned to dirty dusts, then through an Enrichment Chamber to get clean dust, then through a smelter to be turned to an ingot.
This will double your ingot output.

Mekanism is a tech mod that will change the way you play Minecraft.
The mod focuses on breaking down materials to their chemical makeup, and getting the best out of every material you come across.
This mod features Hydrogen-Powered Jetpacks, a mini-robotic friend, reactors, a Digital Miner to automate mining, and much, much more.

This machine works like a Macerator or Pulverizer, and will break ores down into dusts.
This breaks 3 raw ores down into 4 dusts.
This is the start of your Ore Factory. It can also be upgraded to a factory machine, increasing the slots of use.
Tasks: Enrichment ChamberRewards: Raw Iron ×3 Random loot roll 10 XP
Osmium Compressor
Really Only Good For 2 Things
The machine creates two really strong ingots: Refined Glowstone and Refined Obsidian.
It infuses an item with Osmium to create a more powerful ingot.
Tasks: Osmium CompressorRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Crusher
It Crushes Things.
This machine crushes ores into their "dirty dust" forms. This is useful to convert clumps into dirty dust, which can go through an Enrichment Chamber to create the ore dust, which then can be smelted into an ingot.
Tasks: CrusherRewards: Dirty Iron Dust ×2 Random loot roll 10 XP
Digital Miner
A bigger robot friend.
This machine can mine for you!
It is completely configurable, and can even replace mined blocks with cobblestone, or whatever block you provide it with!
Tasks: Digital MinerRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP Random loot roll
Basic Fluid Tank
It has a BUCKET MODE!
Fluid Tanks store liquids.
It has a bucket mode which can be toggled to scoop up liquids with it. Very useful for lava in the beginning!
Tasks: Basic Fluid TankRewards: Bucket 10 XP
Robit
A Mini-Robot To Accompany You On Your Travels
Tasks: RobitRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Jetpack
Requires Hydrogen to Work!
Tasks: JetpackRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Basic Tier Installer
Upgrading to Factories
This item upgrades a base machine to a Basic Factory machine.
Tasks: Basic Tier InstallerRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Advanced Tier Installer
Tasks: Advanced Tier InstallerRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Elite Tier Installer
Tasks: Elite Tier InstallerRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Ultimate Tier Installer
Tasks: Ultimate Tier InstallerRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Quantum Entangloporter
Wireless Power, Gases, Fluids, Everything.
This item is how you make Wireless Transfers possible.
You can set specific channels, named by you, to transfer whatever you want from it.
Tasks: Quantum EntangloporterRewards: Teleportation Core Random loot roll 100 XP
Basic Energy Cube
Storing Power
This block stores power, and can also be used to charge items.
Tasks: Basic Energy CubeRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Advanced Energy Cube
Tasks: Advanced Energy CubeRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Elite Energy Cube
Tasks: Elite Energy CubeRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Ultimate Energy Cube

Infused Alloy
The Basic Alloy for Crafting Items
Infusing a Copper Ingot with Redstone Dust in a Metallurgic Infuser will make an Infused Alloy.
Tasks: Infused AlloyRewards: Redstone 10 XP
Reinforced Alloy
Tasks: Reinforced AlloyRewards: Enriched Diamond 10 XP
Atomic Alloy
Tasks: Atomic AlloyRewards: Refined Obsidian Dust 10 XP
Basic Control Circuit
The Basic Control Circuit
Infusing Osmium with Redstone in a Metallurgic Infuser will create you one of these.
Tasks: Basic Control CircuitRewards: Redstone 10 XP
Advanced Control Circuit
Tasks: Advanced Control CircuitRewards: Enriched Redstone 10 XP
Elite Control Circuit
Tasks: Elite Control CircuitRewards: Reinforced Alloy 10 XP
Ultimate Control Circuit
Tasks: Ultimate Control CircuitRewards: Atomic Alloy 100 XP
Steel
Infusing Iron with Coal or Charcoal in a Metallurgic Infuser will give you Enriched Iron.
Infusing the Enriched Iron with more Coal or Charcoal will give you Steel Dust, which can be smelted into Steel.
This is a major crafting component in a lot of recipes in Mekanism.
Tasks: Steel IngotRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP

For Transferring Power

Refined Obsidian
Tasks: Refined Obsidian IngotRewards: Obsidian Dust ×2 Random loot roll 100 XP
Refined Glowstone
Tasks: Refined Glowstone IngotRewards: Glowstone Dust ×2 100 XP
Purification Chamber
It makes Clumps.
This machine "Purifies" our ores. It turns 1 Raw Ore into 2 "Clumps", which can then be sent through a Crusher to be turned to dirty dusts, then through an Enrichment Chamber to get clean dust, then through a smelter to be turned to an ingot.
This will double your ingot output.
This machine requires Oxygen to run, which is created by pumping water into an Electrolytic Separator.
Tasks: Purification ChamberRewards: Iron Clump ×2 Random loot roll 10 XP
Energized Smelter
Mekanism's Powered Furnace
This machine smelts items.
It can be upgraded into a Smelting Factory, increasing the total number of smelting slots up to a maximum of 9.
Tasks: Energized SmelterRewards: Raw Iron ×2 Random loot roll 10 XP
Electrolytic Separator
Time to Break It Down
The Electrolytic Separator (big fancy name) is used to separate chemicals from certain liquids and gases.
You'll need a bunch of these if you plan on making an Ore Processing Factory.
To start, make one of these and we'll break down the most basic fluid: Water.
Tasks: Electrolytic SeparatorRewards: Infused Alloy Random loot roll 10 XP
Gas-Burning Generator
Burn Gases into Power!
This generator can burn both Hydrogen and Ethylene to produce power.
Note: Burning Hydrogen will not produce more power than it costs to run an Electrolytic Separator. Use for Ethylene instead.
Tasks: Gas-Burning GeneratorRewards: Infused Alloy ×2 Random loot roll 100 XP
Chemical Injection Chamber
Turns 3 Raw Ore into 8 Ore Shards
This machine is the next step to your Ore Processing Factory. Add this to the left of your Purification Chamber to build on to your current ore factory!
This machine requires Hydrogen Chloride to operate. To find out how to create Hydrogen Chloride, follow the quest above!
Tasks: Chemical Injection ChamberRewards: Infused Alloy Random loot roll 100 XP
Chemical Infuser
The Chemical Combiner
This machine combines two gases to create a new gas.
You'll need this to combine Chlorine with Hydrogen to create Hydrogen Chloride, which is then used in our Chemical Injection Chamber.
Tasks: Chemical InfuserRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Thermal Evaporation Plant
Water turns into Brine!
To get Hydrogen Chloride for our machines, we'll need to first create Brine.
To do this, we'll need a Thermal Evaporation Plant. This is a multi-block structure.
To start, create a 4x3x4 structure that is hollow in the middle, except for the base. You can replace any of the sides with a Controller or Valve.
You'll need at least 1 controller, and at least 2 valves.
Pump in water, and you'll start collecting brine, which can be pumped into an Electrolytic Separator to extract Chlorine from the gas.
Tasks: Thermal Evaporation Controller Thermal Evaporation Block ×37 Thermal Evaporation Valve ×2Rewards: Steel Ingot ×2 Random loot roll 100 XP
The Start of a Tier 4 Ore Factory
We will need to add 3 more machines to our current setup.
The first part of the process is the Chemical Dissolution Chamber.
This machine requires Sulfuric Acid to break down raw ores into an "Ore Slurry".
To get Sulfuric Acid, we'll need a new setup, which is explained further in the next quests.
Tasks: Chemical Dissolution ChamberRewards: Refined Obsidian Ingot ×2 Random loot roll 100 XP
Rotary Condensentrator
To make Sulfuric Acid, you'll need to create Water Vapor.
Pump some water into this machine and it'll convert it into vapor.
Tasks: Rotary CondensentratorRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Chemical Oxidizer
Okay, let's start with making Sulfur Dioxide first.
Start by placing Gunpowder in a separate Chemical Injection Chamber with Hydrogen Chloride to create Sulfur Dust. OR you can just pulverize Sulfur from Thermal Series into Sulfur Dust, it's up to you.
Feeding the Sulfur Dust into this machine, the Chemical Oxidizer, will create Sulfur Dioxide. Now we need to create Sulfur Trioxide.
Send the Sulfur Dioxide into a Chemical Infuser to combine it with Oxygen to create Sulfur Trioxide. Send the Trioxide to another Chemical Infuser to combine it with Water Vapor to create Sulfuric Acid.
It's a lot.
Tasks: Chemical Oxidizer SulfurRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Heating Up our Brine Production
Hot Brine here. Get Your Hot Brine here.
The Thermal Evaporation Plant multi-block produces Brine based on the internal temperature.
There are several methods to increase the temperature of the plant, including building them in a desert!
The Fuelwood Heater burns buckets of Lava, which can then be piped in using a pipe that transfers heat.
The Resistive Heater uses RF/FE to produce heat, and can be set to use whatever RF/FE you want it to use.
Tasks: Smart FilterRewards: Thermal Evaporation Valve 10 XP
Custom Portals!
Teleportation at its Finest
To create a custom Portal, place down a single Teleporter block. Connect power to the block.
Create a "Portal Frame" with the teleporter block being the base of the portal.
The final product will be a 4x3 portal structure, with the two blocks in the middle creating the portal.
Tasks: Teleporter Frame ×9 TeleporterRewards: Teleportation Core Random loot roll 100 XP
Energy Tablet
Portable Battery Pack
This item is used to store power, and functions like a portable battery pack.
It is also an important crafting item in Mekanism.
Tasks: Energy TabletRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Speed Upgrade
Tasks: Speed UpgradeRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Energy Upgrade
Tasks: Energy UpgradeRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Filter Upgrade
Tasks: Filter UpgradeRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Muffling Upgrade
shhhhh... too loud....
Tasks: Muffling UpgradeRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Chemical Upgrade
Tasks: Chemical UpgradeRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Stone Generator Upgrade
Tasks: Stone Generator UpgradeRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Configurator
Mekanism's Wrench
This item is used to configure many of the items in Mekanism, from changing pipes to "Pull or Push" or rotating machines.
Tasks: ConfiguratorRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Water Source
The All-Mighty Infinite Water Source
To start breaking down water, we'll need a water source. The Kitchen Sink provides infinite water, and can easily be set up to pump out water.
Alternatively, you can always just use the classic infinite water source with a Pump from Mekanism.
Pump the water into your Electrolytic Separator to split the water into Hydrogen and Oxygen.
Tasks: SinkRewards: Water Bucket 100 XP
Advanced Fluid Tank
Tasks: Advanced Fluid TankRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Elite Fluid Tank
Tasks: Elite Fluid TankRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Ultimate Fluid Tank
Tasks: Ultimate Fluid TankRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP

This block stores gases.
Tasks: Basic Chemical TankRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Advanced Chemical Tank
Tasks: Advanced Chemical TankRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Elite Chemical Tank
Tasks: Elite Chemical TankRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Ultimate Chemical Tank
Tasks: Ultimate Chemical TankRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Solar Generator
Generates about 51FE/t
Generates power from the sun!
Tasks: Solar GeneratorRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Heat Generator
Basic Power Gen
The Heat Generator has 2 modes to generate power:
Passive: Surrounding the generator with lava source or flowing blocks creates passive power by creating heat. Place one lava source block on top, and let it flow over the sides. Make sure to connect pipes first!
Active: Placing combustible materials such as coal or wood into the generator will burn the fuel to create power.
Tasks: Heat GeneratorRewards: Osmium Ingot 10 XP
Bio-Generator
This generator will burn Bio Fuel into energy. It produces around 140FE/t.
Tasks: Bio-GeneratorRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Advanced Solar Generator
Generates about 410FE/t
If you're wondering if it is worth making this upgrade, the answer is yes.
This version can be used to add extra heat to Thermal Evaporation Plants.
Tasks: Advanced Solar GeneratorRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Wind Generator
Generates Power from the Wind
This is a great option for generating power.
This generates around 96FE/t at sea level, and increases based on how high you are. The higher the Y level, the more power it produces!
Tasks: Wind GeneratorRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Mekanism
The Start of Your Own Factory
Mekanism is a tech mod that will change the way you play Minecraft.
The mod focuses on breaking down materials to their chemical makeup, and getting the best out of every material you come across.
This mod features Hydrogen-Powered Jetpacks, a mini-robotic friend, reactors, a Digital Miner to automate mining, and much, much more.
Tasks: Raw OsmiumRewards: Raw Osmium 10 XP
Osmium
The Base Crafting Ingot
Tasks: Osmium IngotRewards: Raw Osmium 10 XP
Quest
Tier 2 Ore Factory
So far, to "double" our ingot output, your setup should look something like this:
Raw Ore goes into your Purification Chamber, which is being fed Oxygen from an Electrolytic Separator.
It then outputs the product into the Crusher, which converts the ore clumps into "Dirty Dusts". This "Dirty Dust" is fed into an Enrichment Chamber, which converts the "Dirty Dust" into the appropriate "Ore Dust."
The Enrichment Chamber then feeds into your preferred smelter of choice.
Tasks: Manual check-offRewards: Infused Alloy 10 XP
Quest
Tier 3 Ore Factory
So now, you should have 5 machines ready to go to process your ores. Are you ready to make it even more complicated?
Your factory should be: Chemical Injection Chamber > Purifying Chamber > Crusher > Enrichment Chamber > Furnace/Smelter.
Easy so far, right?
Well buckle up. It's about to get wild.
Tasks: Manual check-offRewards: 10 XP
Pressurized Reaction Chamber
Combines gases, solid items, and liquids to produce an item and by-product.
This machine is needed to create end-game materials and armor.
Tasks: Pressurized Reaction ChamberRewards: Basic Control Circuit ×2 Random loot roll 10 XP
Bio Fuel
The Crusher can also break down natural substances into Bio Fuel!
Tasks: Bio FuelRewards: Bio Fuel 10 XP
Substrate
When Bio Fuel is combined with Water and Hydrogen in a Pressurized Reaction Chamber it creates Substrates. It also creates Ethylene as a by-product.
These are needed to create HDPE pellets, which are used for end-game crafts like the Meka-suit.
Tasks: SubstrateRewards: Substrate 10 XP
HDPE Pellets
Combining Oxygen, Ethylene, and a Substrate in a Pressurized Reaction Chamber will create an HDPE Pellet.
Tasks: HDPE Pellet ×3Rewards: HDPE Pellet 10 XP
HDPE Sheet
To get an HDPE Sheet, place 3 HDPE Pellets in an Enrichment Chamber.
Tasks: HDPE SheetRewards: HDPE Sheet 100 XP
Atomic Disassembler
Mekanism's All In One Tool
Tasks: Atomic DisassemblerRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP Random loot roll
Smart Filter
Enrich your items first!
Using the Enrichment Chamber, you can enrich items to convert them into Enriched variants.
These "Enriched" items give 8x the amount of mb in a Metallurgic Infuser.
If you plan on making a bunch of steel, Enrich your Charcoal first!
Tasks: Any EnrichedRewards: Enriched Carbon ×2 10 XP
Chemical Washer
Giving Ores a Bath
This machine needs water to operate, and uses the water to clean "Ore Slurry" into "Clean Ore Slurry."
It will be part 2 of your Tier 4 Ore Processing Factory.
Tasks: Chemical WasherRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Chemical Crystallizer
Turns Ore Slurry into Crystals
This machine will be #3 in your Tier 4 Ore Processing Factory.
It takes the Clean Ore Slurry from the Chemical Washer and turns it into Crystals, which the Chemical Injection Chamber can process after.
Tasks: Chemical CrystallizerRewards: Random loot roll 100 XP
Quest
This is a lot, I know.
If you're like me, you probably got lost 55 times during these last few steps. This is a complicated system.
A basic layout of your factory should be:
Raw ore goes into your Chemical Dissolution Chamber > pumps A GAS to Chemical Washer > pumps A GAS to Chemical Crystallizer > outputs crystals to Chemical Injection Chamber > outputs shards to Purification Chamber > outputs clumps to Crusher > outputs dirty dusts to Enrichment Chamber > outputs clean dust to Smelter.
Tasks: Manual check-offRewards: 100 XP
Chargepad
Standing on this item will charge up any powered item from any mod.
This is also needed for the Robit.
Tasks: ChargepadRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Quest

As all AllTheMods packs are licensed under All Rights Reserved, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by AllTheMods Team without explicit permission.

entries.text:
Powah
Welcome to Powah!!!
Powah is a tech mod that's all about generating, storing, and transmitting Power. Ranging from basic FE generation to Reactors that produce 250k FE/t, Powah has you covered!
To get started, go out and mine some Uraninite!
Tasks: Raw UraniniteRewards: Manual (Powah!) Wrench
Starting with Dielectric Mats
Almost every single machine you can make in the mod will require a Dielectric Casing.
You'll need to make the Paste first, as well as some Rods to progress!
Tasks: Dielectric Paste ×16 Dielectric CasingRewards: Dielectric Casing 25 XP
The Energizing Orb
In the beginning, you can get by with creating the Starter and Basic tier machines using Iron, but you'll eventually need to create energized mats using the Energizing Orb.
The Energizing Orb will energize items using nearby Energizing Rods within a 9x9 area around it, creating better materials for you to use to progress through the Tiers in Powah.
To power the orb, you'll need to attach Energizing Rods to Energy Cables that are being supplied with energy. If you want the Orb to energize faster, either make more rods, upgrade to higher tier rods, or both! To see if the Rods are connected, set your Wrench to link mode and you can link any Rod to the Orb.
Tasks: Energizing Orb Smart Filter Smart FilterRewards: Random loot roll 50 XP
Thermo Generator (Starter)
One of the best options for "Passive Power", the Thermal Generator will produce FE when placed over a Heat Source and given a steady supply of water.
There are currently 3 blocks you can place this over: a Magma block which produces the lowest, a lava source block which is a little better, or a Block of Blazing Crystal, which provides the most heat.
Tasks: Thermo Generator (Starter)Rewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Furnator (Starter)
The Furnator will burn items like coal and wood to produce FE.
Tasks: Furnator (Starter)Rewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Solar Panel (Starter)
The Solar Panel generates FE when given direct access to the sun. However, you can use a Lens of Ender to ignore blocks in its way.
Tasks: Solar Panel (Starter)Rewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Magmator (Starter)
The Magmator will generate FE when supplied with Lava.
Tasks: Magmator (Starter)Rewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Reactor (Starter)
The Reactor is a 3x4x3 multiblock generator that burns Urananite as fuel to produce FE.
To build it, you'll need to make a total of 36 Reactor Blocks. While holding 36 in hand, placing one block will auto-build the reactor. Make sure to clear out some room first!
You'll want to cool the reactor down for it to create more FE, and you can do this with either solid or liquid coolant. To use a solid coolant, you'll also need to give it some liquid coolant as well. Dry Ice makes for a great solid coolant! (Note: 1 Water Bucket will do).
You can also increase the FE generation by keeping the fuel buffer full, as well as adding both Coal and Redstone to the Reactor. Using Blocks of either will also work!
Tasks: Reactor (Starter) ×36Rewards: Dry Ice Random loot roll 10 XP
Ender Gate (Starter)
Ender Gates are used to transfer power wirelessly to and from an adjacent block into the Ender Network.
Think of these like wireless access points to your wireless network of power.
Note: You can only add power storage capacity using an Ender Cell.
Tasks: Ender Gate (Starter)Rewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Energy Cable (Starter)
The basic cables for transferring power.
Tasks: Energy Cable (Starter)Rewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Player Transmitter (Starter)
The Player Transmitter will charge a player's items wirelessly. You must first bind this to a player using a Binding Card. This is the basic card which allows the transmitter to only work in the same dimension. You can upgrade this by using a Binding Card (Dimensional) instead.
Note: To get a Player Aerial Pearl, use an Aerial Pearl on a Zombie or Husk.
Tasks: Player Transmitter (Starter) Smart FilterRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Energy Hopper (Starter)
The Energy Hopper will charge any chargeable item inside of the inventory of the block it is pointed to, like a chest.
Tasks: Energy Hopper (Starter)Rewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Energy Discharger (Starter)
This block will drain FE from any charged item.
Tasks: Energy Discharger (Starter)Rewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Energy Cell (Starter)
The Power Bank of Powah.
These can also be used to upgrade the total power storage capacity of your wireless Ender Networks.
Tasks: Energy Cell (Starter)Rewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Ender Cell (Starter)
The Ender Cell will store power for a channel in your Ender Network. To increase the power capacity of the network, right click on the Ender Cell to open up the interface, then add either a Battery or an Energy Cell to increase the overall capacity.
Tasks: Ender Cell (Starter)Rewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
