entries.text:
Apothic Enchanting
Apothic Enchanting
Enchanting gets a few changes with Apotheosis.
To summarize it, 15 Bookshelves won't be enough now.
There's new Bookshelves and actions you can do with Enchantment Tables now and hopefully these quests will help you understand.
Tasks: Enchanting TableRewards: Book ×18 1 XP levels
Vanilla Max is just the start
Bookshelves are your starting point, but definitely not your end point. Atleast not normal Bookshelves.
With only normal Bookshelves you can only get Eterna up and to a max of 30. (I will explain the Enchantment Levels soon but just know you need them up)
Tasks: Any Bookshelves ×15Rewards: Bookshelf ×5 2 XP levels
Infusing
Infusion is a special version of Enchanting which ironically is used for better Enchantments.
When the right amount of Eterna, Quanta, and Arcana is reached the Enchantments will offer Infusion.
(To know the Levels needed you can check EMI or follow these Quests)
Tasks: Advancement: minecraft:story/enchant_itemRewards: Lapis Block ×3 5 XP levels
Other Infusion Items
It's not just Bookshelves that can be Infused!
Tasks: Lapis Lazuli ×3Rewards: Lapis Lazuli ×9 3 XP levels
Making a real Trident
Apotheosis knows how annoying Tridents can be to get so they made it easier... well kinda easier!
You can now make an Inert Trident and Infuse it to get a normal Trident.
The Trident requires between 40 Eterna, 20%-50% Quanta, and atleast 35% Arcana.
You can get this with 1 Bookshelf, 4 Echoing Sculkshelf, and 1 Melonshelf.
Tasks: Inert TridentRewards: Enchanted Book
Enchantment Library
The Enchantment Library is the single greatest Enchanted Book storage, ever!
To Craft it you'll need 4 Ender Chests, 1 Enchanting Table, and 4 of any of the Infused Bookshelves: Infused Hellshelf, Infused Seashelves, and Deepshelves.
To use it, you can either Shift Left Click Enchanted Books or bring them into the Blue Slot. This will add the Books to the Library.
The Books are sorted by name and are held in Points. Each Level of Enchanted Book determines the Level, and it is reflected on how many Books would be needed to get that Level. Level 1, is 1 Point. Level 2 is 2 Points. Level 3 is 4 Points. Level 4 is 8 Points.
Each Book is stored to a max of 32768 Points, and they can be extracted by Left Clicking the stored Book. Each Click will add another Level to the Book in the Orange Slot.
You can Click different Books to add to the Book in the Orange Slot, similar to combining Books in an Anvil.
The max Level of Enchanted Book is determined by the highest Level of Book you've put in. It doesn't matter if you have 32000 Points, if you only put in Sharpness III, you can only take out Sharpness III.
Tasks: Enchantment LibraryRewards: Enchanted Book 3 XP levels
Library of Alexandria
Just imagine if Rome never burned...
The Library of Alexandria is a better Enchantment Library.
It can hold higher Levels of Enchanted Books, but it will still need the Level of Book to get taken out at that Level.
It will also hold more Points. The Enchantment Library can hold 32768, while the Library of Alexandria can hold 1.1 Billion Points of each Book!
To obtain it, we'll need to Infuse the Enchantment Library.
Use 4 Soul-Touched Sculkshelves, 4 Echoing Sculkshelves, 1 Draconic Endshelf, 5 Geode-Encased Bookshelves of Stability, and a Skeleton Skull.
Tasks: Library of AlexandriaRewards: Enchanted Book 10 XP levels
Negative amounts
Some Infusions need very, very exact amounts of Eterna, Quanta, or Arcana.
To get these you might need one of these Shelves.
Each lowers the amount of its respective quantities.
Tasks: Beeshelf Stoneshelf MelonshelfRewards: Lapis Block 5 XP levels
Hellshelves
Hellshelves are your introduction to Quanta, they give 3% Quanta and 3 Eterna.
Better than normal Shelves right?
You're going to want 16 of them for the next step, 15 Hellshelves around the Enchantment Table, with 1 in your Inventory.
Make the first 11 and I'll give you the last 5 Hellshelves!
Tasks: Hellshelf ×11Rewards: Hellshelf ×5 2 XP levels
Infused Hellshelves
Once we get those 15 Hellshelves around our Enchantment Table, we'll have 45 Eterna and 30% Quanta in our Table.
This is the perfect amount to Infuse our Hellshelves!
Infused Hellshelves give 5 Eterna with a max of 60 Eterna, along with 5% Quanta.
These can be Crafted with other Items to make different Bookshelves, for the ones we want we'll need 12 Infused Hellshelves!
Of course, with me being soooo generous, you'll only need to collect 8!
Tasks: Infused Hellshelf ×8Rewards: Infused Hellshelf ×4 5 XP levels
Enchanting Clues
You ever spend 3 months studying Galatic Code to finally understand Enchantment Table language just for it to be gibberish?
No?
Me either, but Enchanting Clues are your actual translator for it!
Each Enchanting Clue will tell you 1 Enchantment before you actually use it.
Tasks: Hellshelf of Sight Hellshelf of Masterful SightRewards: 5 XP levels
Blazing Hellshelf
By combining an Infused Hellshelf with some Glowstone we can make Glowing Hellshelves!
These have the same Eterna and Quanta, but give 3% Arcana.
This will be helpful in later Infusions, like if we wish to use 12 of them to Infuse a Dormant Deepshelf into a Deepshelf!
Tasks: Blazing HellshelfRewards: Blazing Hellshelf 3 XP levels
Glowing Hellshelf
By combining an Infused Hellshelf with some Glowstone we can make Glowing Hellshelves!
These have the same Eterna and Quanta, but give 3% Arcana.
This will be helpful in later Infusions, like if we wish to use 12 of them to Infuse a Dormant Deepshelf into a Deepshelf!
Tasks: Glowing Hellshelf ×12Rewards: Dormant Deepshelf ×3 3 XP levels
Deepshelf
This is where the seperation of Hellshelves and Seashelves end!
First, we'll need to Craft a Dormant Deepshelf. These are just 6 Cracked Deepslate Bricks and 3 Books.
Then, we'll need 60 Eterna, 40% Quanta, and 40% Arcana. We can get that with 12 Crystalline Seashelves or 12 Glowing Hellshelves!
Finally, we can Infuse our Dormant Deepshelves into regular Deepshelves!
Tasks: DeepshelfRewards: Deepshelf ×2 Nature's Compass 7 XP levels
Soul-Touched Deepshelf
Soul-Touched Deepshelves are an upgrade to Deepshelves.
They are Crafted with a Soul Lantern and 3 Sculk Blocks. You'll need Silk Touch to pick up Sculk Blocks.
Then, we can Craft our Soul-Touched version. These will give a ton more Quanta at 15%!
It also increases max Eterna to 75.
Tasks: Soul-Touched DeepshelfRewards: Sculk ×3 5 XP levels
Soul-Touched Sculkshelf
To upgrade Deepshelves even farther, surprisingly we don't need Infusion! Instead we need more Crafting!
First, is 5 Sculk Blocks and a Sculk Catalyst. Both can be found within the Deep Dark and will need Silk Touch to collect.
Last is the Warden Tendril... this is a Drop from the Warden... Yes, you'll need to kill the Warden.
Once you have all that you can Craft one of the best Bookshelves! One that gives 10 Eterna, 15% Quanta, and 10% Arcana.
And most importantly, gives us a max Eterna of 80! Almost to 100!
Tasks: Soul-Touched SculkshelfRewards: Warden Tendril 6 XP levels
Echoing Deepshelf
For the Echoing upgrade we'll need a few different Items.
Candles which are relatively easy to get! And Echo Shards... which definitely aren't...
The best chance at getting them is by Looting an Ancient City, but you can Craft them with a few different Rituals.
(Or even later on with Enchanting!)
The Echoing Deepshelves will give a whole lot more Arcana at 15%! Along with raising the max Eterna to 75.
Tasks: Echoing DeepshelfRewards: Sculk ×4 5 XP levels
Echoing Sculkshelf
To upgrade Deepshelves even farther, surprisingly we don't need Infusion! Instead we need more Crafting!
First, is 5 Sculk Blocks and a Sculk Catalyst. Both can be found within the Deep Dark and will need Silk Touch to collect.
Last is the Warden Tendril... this is a Drop from the Warden... Yes, you'll need to kill the Warden.
Once you have all that you can Craft one of the best Bookshelves! One that gives 10 Eterna, 10% Quanta, and 15% Arcana.
And most importantly, gives us a max Eterna of 80! Almost to 100!
Tasks: Echoing SculkshelfRewards: Warden Tendril 6 XP levels
Endshelves
The last and greatest of the Bookshelves, the Endshelves!
These are created with 6 Endstone Bricks, 1 Ender Pearl, 1 Bookshelf, and of course the Infused Dragon's Breath.
Their stats aren't currently the best, only giving 5 for each. But their max Eterna of 90 is incredible!
Oh yeah plus they can be Crafted with other Items to upgrade them!
Tasks: EndshelfRewards: Endshelf ×2 Dragon Head 15 XP levels
Negative Enchantments Removal
All Enchantments from the Enchantment Table is determined by the Levels of Eterna, Quanta, and Arcana.
We can see the Pool of Enchantments available by clicking the ? in the Top Right of the Enchantment Table's GUI when an Item is being Enchanted.
The higher the Quanta is, the better chance we get a worse Enchantment gets. Ones like Curses of Vanishing or Binding!
With the Geode-Encased Bookshelf of Stability it will get rid of the increased chances of worse Enchantments.
You will still be able to get Curses with it, just at a much lower rate! To Craft it we'll need a Bookshelf, 7 Calcite, and 1 Budding Amethyst.
Budding Amethyst can not be collected from Mining, even with Silk Touch. You'll need either a Ritual or Infusion to get one then!
Tasks: Geode-Encased Bookshelf of StabilityRewards: 5 XP levels
Pearlescent Endshelf
The Pearlescent Endshelf is an alright Shelf especially for the price.
It is created by combining an Endshelf with 4 End Rods and 2 Ender Pearls.
It will give us max Eterna 90, but this isn't what we want for max Enchanting.
Tasks: Pearlescent EndshelfRewards: Ender Pearl ×16 End Stone Bricks ×64 5 XP levels
Draconic Endshelf
The Draconic Shelf is the last Shelf we'll need for perfect set up.
It might only give Eterna but it has the max Eterna of 100.
To Craft it we'll need 5 Ender Pearls and a Dragon Head. That is what makes it Draconic!
To get them you can either use MA or find them on End Ships. End Ships are Structures in The End, on the bow (front) is the Dragon Head.
Tasks: Draconic EndshelfRewards: Draconic Endshelf 15 XP levels
Best Enchanting set-up
Ever want the most perfect Enchantments? Like, every stat maxed out, every good Enchantment available? Then, you'll need these!
First, is the 4 Soul-Touched Sculkshelves and 4 Echoing Sculkshelves. These will give us all the Quanta and Arcana we need!
Next, is the Draconic Endshelf which will give us 100 Eterna, as in amount of Eterna and the max level.
Third, is the Geode-Encased Bookshelf of Stability, this will make it so the Quanta doesn't backstab us with awful Enchantments!
Last is optional but you should add it, the Deepshelf of Arcane Treasures. That Bookshelf will allow us to get Enchantments we normally wouldn't, like Mending!
Tasks: Soul-Touched Sculkshelf ×4 Echoing Sculkshelf ×4 Draconic Endshelf Geode-Encased Bookshelf of Stability Deepshelf of Arcane TreasuresRewards: Book ×32 Lapis Block ×12 30 XP levels
Seashelves
The Nether can be pretty scary, if you'd rather voyage the Sea, use Seashelves!
Seashelves are your introduction to Arcana, they give 3% Arcana and 3 Eterna.
Better than normal Shelves right?
You're going to need 16 for Infusing... well 15 for Infusing, 1 to be Infused!
Like the Hellshelves, I'll give you extra, just collect 11 now!
Tasks: Seashelf ×11Rewards: Seashelf ×5 2 XP levels
Infused Seashelf
With the 15 Seashelves around the Enchanting Table, we can Infuse our last Seashelf!
Infused Seashelves give more Eterna at 5 with a max of 60. Also more Arcana at 5%.
These can be Crafted into different Bookshelves, the ones we're looking for, for Max Enchanting is the Crystalline Seashelf.
We'll need 12 of those, so we'll need 12 Infused Seashelves. Craft 8 and I'll reward you the rest!
Tasks: Infused Seashelf ×8Rewards: Infused Seashelf ×4 5 XP levels
Remove Enchantments from Pool
If you want to remove a specific Enchant from Enchantment Pool, you can use this Bookshelf in your Enchanting set up!
Place an Enchantment Book, you want to Blacklist, in an empty spot in this Seashelf.
Then, when you Enchant, this Enchantment won't show up on Items or Books.
Tasks: Seashelf of Aquatic FiltrationRewards: Enchanted Book Enchanted Book 5 XP levels
Heart-Forged Seashelf
The Heart-Forged Seashelf is another upgrade to the Infused Seashelf.
It's a little expensive but gives lots of Arcana!
This will be very helpful for later Infusions needing lots of Arcana.
Tasks: Heart-Forged SeashelfRewards: Heart-Forged Seashelf 3 XP levels
Crystalline Seashelf
We can Craft Infused Seashelves with Prismarine Crystals to get Crystalline Seashelves.
The Crystalline Seashelves will keep the same 5 Eterna, 5% Arcana, and now have 3% Quanta.
With 12 of them, we can get enough Levels to Infuse Dormant Deepshelves into normal Deepshelves!
Tasks: Crystalline Seashelf ×12Rewards: Dormant Deepshelf ×3 3 XP levels
Arcana
Arcana is very important quantity, it increases the amount of Enchantments you get; and makes rare Enchantments more common.
An example with Swords would be like, Smite is a very common Enchantment but Looting is much more rare.
Arcanas default is 0% and max is 100%.
Tasks: SeashelfRewards: Seashelf ×2 3 XP levels
Eterna
Eterna sets the Enchantment Level which determines what Enchantments you can or will get!
It's default is 0 and max is 50.
Almost all Bookshelves will give Eterna but each has max they can set it to.
Tasks: Any BookshelvesRewards: Bookshelf ×2 3 XP levels
Quanta
Quanta helps to mix up the Enchantment Pool, making it easier to get a whole bunch of different Enchantments.
Quanta can work against you though, the more you have it, the more common Bad Enchantments will get. Bad Enchantments like Curse of Binding!
Before we used Rectification, instead we now use Geode-Encased Bookshelves of Stability!
Default Quanta is 15% and its max is 100%.
Tasks: HellshelfRewards: Hellshelf ×2 3 XP levels
Infused Dragon's Breath
Now that we have our max Eterna of 80, we can start Infusing Dragon's Breath!
Dragon's Breath can be obtained when fighting the Ender Dragon. When she is perched above her nest she might shoot a Pink mist at you. When in it, you can Right Click with an Empty Bottle, to obtain Dragon's Breath!
The best way to get our Levels is with 4 Echoing Sculkshelves, 4 Soul-Touched Sculkshelves, and 6 Geode-Encased Bookshelves of Stability.
These will give us 80 Eterna, 25% Quanta and 100% Arcana. Perfect for Infusion!
Tasks: Infused Dragon's BreathRewards: Dragon Breath ×5 10 XP levels
Making Budding Amethyst
Budding Amethyst can be useful for Crafting Recipes and even just Growing Amethyst!
With a Amethyst Block, 60 Eterna, between 30% and 50% Quanta, and 50% Arcana we can Infuse one.
To get all those stats we can use 15 Glowing Hellshelves and 4 Melonshelves.
Tasks: Budding AmethystRewards: Budding Amethyst ×2 Amethyst Shard ×10
Infinite Echo Shards?
Echo Shards can be pretty annoying to farm, plus we'll need a lot of them! So why not have an easier way of Farming them.
With Infusion we can make 1 Echo Shard into 4!
We'll need 70 Eterna, 50% Quanta, and 50% Arcana.
To get that, we can use 12 Glowing Hellshelves and 2 Deepshelves, that aren't Dormant!
Tasks: Echo ShardRewards: Echo Shard ×2
Unbreakable Charms
The worst part about Charms is that they break! Why would these OP Potion Effects have to have Durability!
Well don't you worry, Apotheosis has a cure for that... with Infusions!
You'll need 100 Eterna, between 8.5% and 13.5% Quanta, and between 32.5% and 37.5% Arcana.
You can use 10 Glowing Hellshelves, 4 Geode-Encased Bookshelves of Stability, 2 Draconic Endshelves, and a Skeleton Skull!
Yes, some Skulls and other Items besides Bookshelves give stats!
Tasks: Any CharmRewards: 5 XP levels Toast
Tome of Scrapping
Half Enchantments, breaks Items
With 8 Books and an Anvil we can make the Tome of Scrapping. Well actually 8 of them, but you get the picture!
By combining an Item with the Tome in an Anvil, we can take half the Enchantments off the Item.
This will end up breaking and voiding the Item after it is done. I don't recommend using it, rather you should upgrade it!
Tasks: Tome of ScrappingRewards: Anvil
Tomes
Tomes are Books... just more useful Books!
Each Tome is Crafted with Books, Sticks, Blaze Rods and Powder.
Tomes can be Enchanted, like Items, to get certain Enchantments.
There is also the Tomes of Scrapping which can be used in Anvils to take Enchantments off Items.
Tasks: BookRewards: Blaze Rod ×3 Stickiest Stick ×6
Tome of Superior Scrapping
All Enchantments, breaks Item
The Tome of Scrapping will only take off half the Enchantments, while the Tome of Superior Scrapping will take every Enchantment off the Item!
Both of these Tomes will break the Item in use though.
To Infuse our Tome of Scrapping into a Tome of Superior Scrapping we can use 3 Soul-Touched Sculkshelves and 1 Draconic Endshelf.
Tasks: Tome of Superior ScrappingRewards: 2 XP levels
Tome of Extraction
All Enchantments, doesn't break
The Tome of Extraction is the Tome we are looking for! It will take off all Enchantments and leave the Item alone!
To make it we'll need to Infuse our Tome of Superior Scrapping.
We can just add another Soul-Touched Sculkshelf to our previous Table to get enough!
Tasks: Tome of ExtractionRewards: 4 XP levels
Armor Tomes
Armor Tomes are used to get Enchantments which are only used on Armor. All of the Tomes can get Protection, Blast Protection, and Fire Protection.
Each also gives ones reserved for a certain part of the Armor. Boots will give Depth Strider and Helmets will give Aqua Affinity.
If you want the best chance for just Protection try the Chestplate Tome!
Tasks: Smart FilterRewards: Enchanted Book
Weapon Tomes
Tomes of Weaponry will give Enchantments for Swords and Axes.
Mostly the ones that help with Killing things! Like Sharpness and Fire Aspect. Tomes of Archery will give Enchantments for ranged Weapons, the Bow and Crossbow.
Piercing, Power, and Knockback!
Tasks: Smart FilterRewards: Enchanted Book
Tool Tomes
The Tome of Miners will help you with all your Mining. It will give Efficiency, Fortune, and Silk Touch.
These work for Pickaxes, Axes, Shovels, and even Hoes!
Tome of the Fishers will only give Fishing Rod Enchantments, and yeah there is a lot.
Tasks: Smart FilterRewards: Enchanted Book
ETC. Tomes
The rest of the Enchantments come from this Tome.
Unbreaking... I don't really know what else...
Tasks: Tome of the OthersRewards: Enchanted Book
Crafting EXP?
EXP is very important for Apotheosis Enchanting! Every Enchant requires it! (Why do you think I give it in every Reward?)
With Infusion we can transform Honey Bottles into Bottles O' Enchanting. Actually we get 3 different Infusions for it! It goes from 1 Bottle O' Enchanting, to 8, to 32!
First, is for 1 Bottle and needs only 2 Echoing Sculkshelves.
Second, is for 8 Bottles and needs 5 Echoing Sculkshelves and 1 Soul-Touched Sculkshelf.
Last, is for 32 Bottles O' Enchanting and will need 5 Echoing Sculkshelves, 3 Soul-Touched, and 1 Draconic Endshelf!
Tasks: Honey BottleRewards: Experience Bottle ×8

entries.text:
Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks
SpellBooks!
Spellbooks! Where else would you put Spells?
You can add Scrolls to a Spellbook by putting both into an Inscription Table. They have a certain amount they can hold but no longer having to worry about Rarity.
When Scrolls are added to your Spellbook they won't be consumed but rather Mana will be consumed.
Tasks: PaperRewards: Paper ×3
Ancient Codex
A Craftable Spell Book... yeah it's not easy to craft.
Hardest to get would be the Ruined Book, which you can find in Ancient City Chests. Blood Vials can be obtained from either putting a Mob (or even yourself) into a Cauldron above a Campfire or an Alchemical Cauldron. Bottle O' Lightning comes from using a Bottle on a Charged Creeper.
Once you do all that you can craft the Ancient Codex. Its 12 Spell Slots is very helpful!
Tasks: Ancient CodexRewards: Legendary Ink
Allthemodium Spell Book
Combine an Ancient Codex with an Allthemodium Ingot and Template in a Smithing Table.
You can get the Template from Brushing Suspicious Clay in an Ancient City.
Tasks: Allthemodium Spell BookRewards: AllTheModium Smithing Template
Vibranium Spell Book
Combine the Allthemodium Spell Book with a Vibranium Ingot and Template in a Smithing Table.
This template can be obtained from Brushing Suspicious Soul Sand in a Bastion.
Tasks: Vibranium Spell BookRewards: Vibranium Smithing Template
Unobtainium Spell Book
The best Spell Book you can imagine! 15 Spell Slots! Are there even 15 Spells?!?! Oh wait yeah there is 15 isn't that much...
Do the same as before: previous Book, Ingot, and Template.
Tasks: Unobtainium Spell BookRewards: Unobtainium Smithing Template
Flimsy Journal
The most basic Spellbook, which also makes it the cheapest!
It can only hold a total of 5 Spells.
Tasks: Flimsy JournalRewards: Common Ink
Ironbound Journal
Not much better than the Flimsy one...
This can hold a single Spell more than the Flimsy Journal! That's one more very powerful Spell at the ready!
Tasks: Ironbound TomeRewards: Uncommon Ink
Apprentice's Spell Book
Another craftable Spellbook, this one's a little more expensive! It'll need Hogskin which is a drop from Hoglins.
This one can hold 8 Spells which is technically still on the low side but it's better!
Tasks: Apprentice's Spell BookRewards: Rare Ink
Enchanted Spell Book
Another Craftable Spell Book and following the pattern this one is even more expensive. It requires Arcane Clothes, Gold, and an Enchanted Book. It's not picky on which Book just needs to be Enchanted!
It has 10 Spell Slots and grants a huge Mana Boost!
Tasks: Enchanted Spell BookRewards: Epic Ink
Rotten Spell Book
It's here! It's there! It's everywhere and it's rotten! You can find these in most Chests.
They can hold 8 Spells but give you less Spell Resistance.
Tasks: Rotten Spell BookRewards: Rare Ink
Grimore of Evokation
Evokers are known as being a powerful and deadly Miniboss of Minecraft. So of course Iron added an even more powerful and deadly version! And yes this Book is a rare drop from both!
It has 10 Spell Slots but 3 are occupied. Fang Strike, Fang Ward, and Vex Swarm all come with the Book and can not be moved.
Also gives a boost to Evocation!
Tasks: Grimoire of EvokationRewards: Epic Ink
Necronomicom
To obtain this special Spell Book you'll need to slay the Dead King!
It has 10 Spell Slots but 4 are taken up already. Blood Slash, Blood Step, Ray of Siphoning, and Blaze Storm come on it already and can't be taken off.
Tasks: NecronomiconRewards: Epic Ink
Blaze Instruction Manual
Hot! Hot! Hot!
This Spell Book is a rare drop from Blazes. I remember that because I was confused when I got 1 from my Blaze Farm.
It gives a Boost to Fire Spells and has 10 Spell Slots.
Tasks: Blaze Instruction ManualRewards: Epic Ink
Villager Bible
This one takes awhile to explain so have patience.
First, find an Evoker Fort. Next, find a Research Book hidden in it. Then, have a Trader who's hostage in the Fort translate it. (Like our hostage Quest Translators!) Once, it's translated bring it to a Priest in a Village to trade it for the Spell Book!
It gives a boost to Holy Spells and don't worry the hostage Traders are very very rare, keep looking!
Tasks: Villager BibleRewards: Epic Ink
Druidic Tome
Nature's Spell Book.
It has 10 Spells and gives a boost to Nature Spells!
You need a Rotten Spell Book to craft it though...
Tasks: Druidic TomeRewards: Epic Ink
Dragonskin Spell Book
Another that needs the Ruined Book to Craft. You can find the Ruined Books in Ancient City Chests.
You'll also need Dragon Skin which drops from the Ender Dragon!
It will have 12 Spell Slots and give a boost to Ender Spells!
Tasks: Dragonskin Spell BookRewards: Legendary Ink
Inscription Table
A very important block and a very common one! Can be crafted or found in most Iron Spells Structures.
These are used for adding and removing Scrolls from Spell Books! Throw the Spell Book in the Book Slot then the Scroll below it. If you want to remove a Scroll, click it then take it from the right and into your Inventory.
Tasks: Inscription TableRewards: Paper ×3
Arcane Anvil
The Arcane Anvil has the most uses out of any block in Iron Spells.
You can combine Spells with the same Ink to level it up. It can combine Scrolls into Weapons to be used with them, like a Sword. You can also set an Affinity to Rings using Upgrade Orbs, or add Upgrade Orbs to Weapons and Gear.
Tasks: Arcane AnvilRewards: Empty Upgrade Orb ×3
Scroll Forge
Scroll Forge, you can guess what it does!
It makes Scrolls!
Add an Ink to set the Rarity. Paper for the actual Scroll. Then the Item of what type of Spell you want (Blaze Rod for Fire, Poisonous Potato for Nature, ETC). Finally chose the Spell you want and it'll be created!
Tasks: Scroll ForgeRewards: Rare Ink ×3
Alchemist Cauldron
Definitely better than a Normal Minecraft Cauldron!
The Alchemist Cauldron can: 1. Be used to get Blood by cooking Mobs or the Player. 2. Make and upgrade Potions. 3. Have half a chance at getting Ink from a Scroll. 4. Combine 4 Ink of a Rarity to a higher Rarity.
Tasks: Alchemist CauldronRewards: Oakskin Elixir Invisibility Elixir Evasion Elixir
Common Ink
Tasks: Common InkRewards: Common Ink ×2
Uncommon Ink
Tasks: Uncommon InkRewards: Uncommon Ink ×2
Rare Ink
Tasks: Rare InkRewards: Rare Ink ×2
Epic Ink
Tasks: Epic InkRewards: Epic Ink ×2
Legendary Ink
Tasks: Legendary InkRewards: Legendary Ink ×2
Lightning
Ride the Lightning! Lightning is all about using Electricity to kill and support yourself. Some attacks even work as real Lightning!
Lightning's Focus Material is Bottle 'O Lightning which you get from using an Empty Bottle on a Charged Creeper. You need the Lightning to make more Lightning!
Its Scrolls are Grey with Light Blue text.
Tasks: Lightning RuneRewards: Lightning Rune ×4
Classes
Runes are how we make our Classes and their parts. To get a Blank Rune you can either kill the Dead King or wipe clean an Inscribed Rune with a Shriving Stone.
There's 8 different classes (1 secret one) each having their own Scrolls, Focus Material, Upgrades, and Outfits.
Tasks: Blank RunestoneRewards: Blank Runestone ×3
Lightning Upgrade Orb
Tasks: Lightning Upgrade OrbRewards: Lightning Upgrade Orb
Fire
Fire is obviously related to Fire. Most of the Scrolls are with using Fire to burn and hurt things.
Fire's Focus Material is Blaze Rods. You can craft Fire Runes or get them from killing the Pyromancer.
Its Scrolls are Light Red with Grey text.
Tasks: Fire RuneRewards: Fire Rune ×4
Ice
Ice is all about Winter time Spells. Using Ice and Snow to chill and harm enemies.
Ice's Focus Material is the Frozen Bone which are drops from Strays. You can use those to craft the Ice Rune or kill the Cryomancer to get it.
Its Scrolls are Light Blue with a Darker Blue text.
Tasks: Ice RuneRewards: Ice Rune ×4
Ender
Ender is used for taking all the powers of Endermen and the Ender Dragon, and of course using it for ourselves. Teleporting, Fireballs, and Dragon's Breath are only a few of these!
Ender's Focus Material is the Ender Pearls.
And its Scrolls are Purple with Pink text.
Tasks: Ender RuneRewards: Ender Rune ×4
Holy
Holy is for all the Medic/Support players. It's mostly meant for healing and helping.
Holy's Focus Material is Divine Pearls which are crafted. You can make Runes with those or kill the Priest to get Holy Runes.
Holy Scrolls are White with Gold texts.
Tasks: Holy RuneRewards: Holy Rune ×4
Blood
This one is single-handly taking us from E10 to Teen rating. Blood is all about slaying enemies for your own Health! Most attacks will heal you back.
Blood's Focus Material is Blood Vials which you get from cooking a Mob or Player in a Cauldron.
Its Scrolls are Brown (there's no color for Brown) with Dark Red texts.
Tasks: Blood RuneRewards: Blood Rune ×4
Evocation
Evocation: To invoke a Spirit or Deity.
Evokation is all about what Evokers do, mainly summoning. Whether it be Fangs or Vexes if it's summoned it's most likely an Evokation.
Evokation's Focus Material is Emeralds. You can either craft the Rune or get it from the Archevoker.
Evokation Scrolls are White with Black texts.
Tasks: Evocation RuneRewards: Evocation Rune ×4
Nature
Nature is made for using the Earth to our advantage by Poisoning and Weakening our enemies! Just like what Big Corporations do to the Earth itself! Nature's Focus Material is Poisonous Potato.
The Scrolls are Light Green with Dark Green text.
Tasks: Nature RuneRewards: Nature Rune ×4
Fire Upgrade Orb
Tasks: Fire Upgrade OrbRewards: Fire Upgrade Orb
Ice Upgrade Orb
Tasks: Ice Upgrade OrbRewards: Ice Upgrade Orb
Ender Upgrade Orb
Why is it wet? Was it in a Lake?
Tasks: Ender Upgrade OrbRewards: Ender Upgrade Orb
Holy Upgrade Orb
Tasks: Holy Upgrade OrbRewards: Holy Upgrade Orb
Blood Upgrade Orb
Tasks: Blood Upgrade OrbRewards: Blood Upgrade Orb
Evocation Upgrade Orb
Tasks: Evocation Upgrade OrbRewards: Evocation Upgrade Orb
Nature Upgrade Orb
Tasks: Nature Upgrade OrbRewards: Nature Upgrade Orb
Pyromancer Outfit
I hope you didn't steal this from the Pyromancer, he's the nice one!
Tasks: Pyromancer Hat Pyromancer Robe Pyromancer Leggings Pyromancer BootsRewards: Arcane Essence ×10
Cryomancecr Outfit
He was mean you can steal it I don't care.
Tasks: Cryomancer Hood Cryomancer Coat Cryomancer Leggings Cryomancer BootsRewards: Arcane Essence ×10
Electromancer Outfit
When's this one going to come to the Mod?
Tasks: Electromancer Hat Electromancer Robe Electromancer Leggings Electromancer BootsRewards: Arcane Essence ×10
Shadow-Walker Outfit
Tasks: Shadow-Walker Mask Shadow-Walker Armor Shadow-Walker Leggings Shadow-Walker BootsRewards: Arcane Essence ×10
Priest Outfit
I heard you can just take online classes to become one now.
Tasks: Priest Mask Priest Robes Priest Leggings Priest BootsRewards: Arcane Essence ×10
Cultist Outfit
Tasks: Cultist Hood Cultist Armor Cultist Leggings Cultist BootsRewards: Arcane Essence ×10
Archevoker Outfit
He may be evil, but he still is fashionable.
Tasks: Archevoker Hat Archevoker Coat Archevoker Leggings Archevoker BootsRewards: Arcane Essence ×10
Plagued Outfit
Very popular around Halloween!
Tasks: Plagued Mask Plagued Coat Plagued Leggings Plagued BootsRewards: Arcane Essence ×10
Catacombs
The biggest and hardest Structure from Iron's Spells.
These are deep underground structures similar to Trial Chambers. You can also use Wayward Compasses to help find it!
In it are plenty of Spawners, Trial Spawners, and of course Loot.
The most important room is the Throne Room, once you arrive there, the Skeleton of the Dead King will reanimate! (If it doesn't you might need to click him).
Tasks: StructureRewards: Arcane Essence ×8
The Dead King
Sitting on the Throne lies the remains of a past King. But once you come close, and touch them, you will see them reanimate; the King is dead no longer! But only murder will keep him alive... and well you're the closest living thing.
The Dead King is the hardest Boss, he has 400 Hearts and is the only to have an actual Boss Bar (and music). He can use a variety of Spells from any class, Poison Arrow from Nature to Blight from Holy to even Fangs from Evokation! He can also teleport, summon the dead, and hit you with the Blood Staff.
If you can kill him he will drop Scrolls of all sorts, Blank Runes, and possibly drop the Blood Staff and Necronomicon.
Tasks: Kill The Dead KingRewards: Blank Runestone ×5
Evoker Fort
The heavily guarded Fortress is home to the Archevoker and his followers. You'll know you see it by its huge Spruce Walls and the giant Stone Fortress inside of them.
Illagers, Vindicators, Evokers, and Ravagers can be found within the Walls and Fortress. Once you get past them you can find your way up the stairs, parkour to the Roof, and meet the Leader of the Fort at the top.
With it being heavily guarded of course there is a ton of loot within the Fort.
Tasks: StructureRewards: Arcane Essence ×8
Archevoker
At the top of the Fort lies the Archevoker. Hostile to only the Player and whoever attacks him.
He has 60 Hearts, and attacks like a normal Evoker plus more! Fireworks, Shield, and Blast of Wind!
Once killed he will drop Arcane Essence, Inks, Evokation Runes, Evokation Scrolls, and rare drop of the Grimore of Evokation!
Tasks: Kill ArchevokerRewards: Evocation Rune ×3
Mangrove Hut
Deep in the muddy Mangrove Swamps lies the refuge of the hermit like Mob called the Apotheocarist.
With nobody near, and only what he needs for his Potions is around.
You can find the Apotheocarist in his Hut.
There you can also find Cauldrons and Brewing Stands with Potions!
Tasks: StructureRewards: Arcane Essence ×8
Apothecarist
Just like the Piglins the Apotheocarist resembles, he is also Neutral. He doesn't care about Gold like his fellow Piglins though, just people who attack him.
You can trade with him: giving him either Emeralds or Potion Ingrediants for Potions, Potion Ingrediants, and Nature Scrolls.
If you wish to slay him he has 60 Hearts. He will attack you with Potions and Nature Spells. When hurt he will try to heal with Potions, (I think he really likes Potions).
When killed he will drop Arcane Essence, Inks, Nature Runes, and Nature Scrolls!
Tasks: Kill ApothecaristRewards: Nature Rune ×3
Pyromancer Tower
The Burned Tower of the Pyromancer. Some say if you're close enough to see the Tower, then you're close enough to feel the heat from it.
The Pyromancer Tower is a burned tower of mainly Stone types with the inside being made of Spruce and Oak. There is also a second Building close to the Tower that is part of the structure as well.
At the top you will find what's causing the smoke as well as an Armor Pile.
If you'd like to find the Pyromancer you'll need to venture down into the Basement!
Tasks: StructureRewards: Arcane Essence ×8
Pyromancer
The Pyromancer (different from the Pie Romancer) is another Neutral Mob added by Iron's Spells. He will maybe set Mobs that are close to him on fire though...
You can trade him all things Fire, Ink, and even Fire Scrolls.
If you want to risk all the hair on your body by fighting him be prepared, he has 60 Hearts. He will set you on Fire with Fire Spells, not even a question.
On death he will drop Arcane Essence, Inks, Fire Runes, and Fire Spells!
Tasks: Kill PyromancerRewards: Fire Rune ×3
Mountain Tower
High above the Mountains, high above the Clouds rests another Tower. This one giving you shivers down your spine.
The Tower is made of Stone, Dark Oak, and Deepslate. It has a second Tower branching off of it. There is a staircase on the outside that leads to the first floor. From there you can climb the inside staircase to go up to the bedroom or second tower.
Or you can venture behind that staircase down the Ladder to the Basement, where the Cryomancer will most likely be.
In the Tower you can find Inscription Tables, Amethyst, and Loot Chests!
Tasks: StructureRewards: Arcane Essence ×8
Cryomancer
Shouldn't have come into the Tower, the Cryomancer does not like Players, they are Hostile to you.
The Cryomancer will immediately start attacking you with Ice Spells. Might even use animals against you! Sacrificing animals to win a fight, he really is cold-hearted!
Once killed he will drop Arcane Essence, Inks, Ice Runes, and Ice Scrolls.
Tasks: Kill CryomancerRewards: Ice Rune ×3
Ancient Battleground
Ancient Battlegrounds are only a fragment of the past.
Who knows what happened.
Who knows who fought who. All we have now are parts of the walls and these Piles of Armor. Might as well just pick them up by Mining them with your Pickaxe.
Tasks: StructureRewards: Diamond Pickaxe
Ancient Knight
After trying to harvest the Piles of Armor they appear to come back to life as if there was a body using it.
They have 60 Hearts and they are different from other bosses as they don't use magic, rather I believe they are something made from magic. They will attack using their Sword either by swinging it or charging at you with it.
From what I've seen they will attack everything they see besides other Knights!
Once killed they dropped Netherite Scraps and Cinder Essence, that should definitely be of good use!
Tasks: Kill Ancient KnightRewards: Cinder Essence ×5
Iron's Spells 'N Spellbooks
Iron has brought us a wonderful and very fun Magic Mod! Iron's Spells 'N Spellbooks!
Iron's Spells is all about making and using Spells! Each Spell has a Rarity, Level, and Class! And everyone of them can be used in a Spellbook.
You won't be able to just make whatever you want with Iron and Redstone, you'll need to get off your butt, Adventure, and Fight!
Tasks: Arcane EssenceRewards: Arcane Essence ×10
Village
Just about every Village can have Priests in them. This includes modded Villages.
Usually they hang in the middle of the Village like by the Markets. Not every Village will have one.
Tasks: StructureRewards: Arcane Essence ×8
Priest
The Neutral protector of the Village. He will attack all nearby Hostile Mobs. Like an Iron Golem but he look familiar for some reason? Could it be someone we know in a costume?
You can trade Healing Potions with him and Emeralds for a Furled Map which will soon be made to help against Evoker Forts!
If you do wish to kill him he will repeatedly attack you with Holy Spells. He will also Heal himself when getting low.
Once killed he will drop Arcane Essence, Inks, Holy Runes, and Holy Scrolls.
Tasks: Kill PriestRewards: Holy Rune ×3
Adventure Time!
There's 6 structures in the Overworld that the bosses can spawn in! (There's a 7th but no boss in there).
Tasks: Visit OverworldRewards: Map
On a Highway to...
&cThe Nether&r!
Tasks: Visit The NetherRewards: 50 XP
Necromancers
These can spawn almost anywhere Vanilla Hostile Mobs spawn in. They aren't bosses, just more Enemies!
They have 25 Points of Health and have mulitple attacks: Fangs from the ground like what Evokers do and a Snowball they can shoot you with.
They can also summon Zombies and Skeletons to help fight you. These won't drop anything and spawn with Armor from the ground.
They will drop Arcane Essence on death along with sometimes a Scroll!
Tasks: Kill NecromancerRewards: Tarnished Crown
The Last Class...
There is a final class of Spells I forgot to mention. Well all knowledge of these Spells have been forgotten so it's not just me.
In order to regain memories we need to walk, quietly, down memory lane. Which happens to be the Ancient City.
Tasks: BiomeRewards: Enchanted Book
Into the Ancient City
You can find the fragments of Ancient Knowledge spread out in the Chests of the Ancient City.
You'll also need Echo Shards to 1. Combine the Fragments to learn of the Spells and 2. Actually make the Spells.
Tasks: Ancient Knowledge FragmentRewards: Ancient Knowledge Fragment ×3
Eldritch
When you finally combine the Ancient Knowledge Fragments you'll get the... Eldritch Manuscript! That's what the last class is!
Eldritch is the last class, the most powerful of all Spells. They are crafted with Echo Shards and need to be learned from the Manuscript to use them. Each Manuscript is only one use.
Tasks: Eldritch ManuscriptRewards: Echo Shard

entries.text:
Occultism
Dreaming of Demons
Welcome to Occultism!
This mod aimes to help the player in many different ways by enlisting the help of Demons Spirits! Don't worry, most of them are friendly. Most.
To get started, you'll need to get some Demon's Fruit Seeds.
Tasks: Demon's Dream SeedsRewards: 10 XP
Little Book o' Demons
The Dictionary Of Spirits serves as the Guide Book for Occultism. You'll absolutely need to make this if you want to continue with the mod!
The Dictionary has a quest-style guide inside of it if you'd rather read it instead of doing these quests!
You'll also need the book to craft several things in the pack, so you kind of have to make it. :)
Tasks: Dictionary Of SpiritsRewards: 10 XP
Demon Fruit
Get Ready for a Trip
Demon's Dream Fruit is perfectly healthy for you. There might be some side effects you should know about.
When you consume one, you have a chance to get the effect of the Third Eye, allowing you to see into the The Otherworld. Certain items in the world might not be what they seem, and you'll need this "vision" to find certain items for progression.
Or you can set it on fire and skip finding most of them. That's up to you.
Tasks: Demon's DreamRewards: 10 XP
The Flames of The Otherworld
What if I told you that the Demon's Fruit is flammable?
Throwing our Demon's Dream Fruit down and setting it on fire will create Spiritfire. This is how we'll convert some overworld items into Otherworld materials.
It's also pretty.
Tasks: Flint And SteelRewards: Demon's Dream ×2 10 XP
Spiritfire Conversions
Using Spiritfire, we can convert several Overworld mats into their Otherworld variants. You can also find several Otherworld mats by going under the effects of the Third Eye and adventuring into the world. You might be surprised what you find. To make it easier, there are crafting recipes for the basic materials by throwing them into Spiritfire.
Andesite converts to Otherstone, which can be used to light a permanent Spiritfire.
Oak Saplings convert to Oak Saplings but they are not the same. When grown, these will look exactly like a regular Oak tree. However, under the effects of the Third Eye, you will be able to harvest the Otherworld variant.
If you have trouble collecting the logs (if they turn into regular Oak Logs even with Third Eye), try collecting them from the top.
Diamonds will turn into Spirit Attuned Gems which are used in several recipes we'll need later on.
Tasks: Otherstone Unstable Otherworld Sapling Spirit Attuned GemRewards: Loot 50 XP
Preparing for a Ritual: Candles
Demons like Candles. I think.
For almost every Ritual to summon our friends, you'll need some Candles. You can create the Butcher Knife and kill some pigs, cows, sheep, horses, or even the Trader Llamas to get some Tallow to make them. Matter of fact, you should definitely find the Trader Llamas. I hear they make good candles. I totally didn't just make that up.
Otherwise, Vanilla Candles can also work!
Spirit Attuned Crystals are also used in several Rituals, so might as well make some now!
Tasks: Any Candles ×4 Spirit Attuned Crystal ×2
Preparing for a Ritual: Chalk
Before we start enlisting the help of our Demon friends, we will need to create the most important item needed for Rituals: Chalk.
There are several colors of chalk needed, with higher level Rituals requiring several to activate. To start with, White Chalk is the easiest to get.
Start by tossing Otherstone in a furnace, and tossing Otherworld Logs into Spiritfire. With the items you create, you'll be able to make the Impure White Chalk.
To purify any piece of Chalk, simply throw it into Spiritfire to cleanse it. Using the Purified Chalk on the ground will draw demonic pretty symbols on the ground. These are a pain to remove, unless of course, you make yourself the Chalk Brush. Do it, it's worth it.
Tasks: Impure White Chalk White Chalk Chalk Brush
Preparing for a Ritual: Bowls
What is a Demonic Ritual without a Sacrifice! :D
Most of the time, Demons just like items so don't be too afraid yet. However, if you have a favorite Cow, you might need to be worried. Sorry Betsy.
Sacrifical Bowls are used to place items needed for Rituals. These can be placed anywhere within the Ritual, as long as it isn't convering up any of the required Chalk.
For now, you'll only need four, but later on you'll need upwards of ten bowls for each ritual!
The Golden Sacrificial Bowl is used in the middle of the Ritual to activate it, and also usually needs a Book of Binding for the Ritual in it.
Tasks: Sacrificial Bowl ×4 Golden Ritual Bowl
Books of Binding
For us to specify which Demon Friend we want to summon, we'll need to make a specific Book of Binding.
To make this, you'll need to purify some Black Dye in Spiritfire to get Purified Ink. With this, we're going to make our first Book of Binding which will summon a Foliot Demon.
Alternatively, you can make an Empty Book of Binding, which can be dyed later to fit whatever tier of ritual you need.
Tasks: Purified Ink Book of Binding: Foliot
Our First Ritual
Aviar's Circle
The first type of ritual we'll be performing is the Summoning Ritual. These rituals are used to summon different types of useful Demons to assist you in crushing, smelting, and more as you get to higher tiers of rituals.
For our first ritual, we want to summon a Foliot Crusher Demon. This Demon will crush items for us, which is something we'll need to make some of the higher level Chalks!
To start with, combine your Unbound Book with your Dictionary of Spirits in a crafting grid. This will bind a Demon to the Book, which is what we'll need for the ritual.
Speaking about your Dictionary of Spirits, it's time to open it up! On the left, click on the Pentacles tab and click on Aviar's Circle. You might have to advance through it by reading a little bit. There is also a way to click \"Mark All As Read\" so it unlocks everything in the Book.
This is what we're going to use to summon our new friend. On the right side, you can click the eye in the bottom-left corner of the image to build an outline of the ritual for you in the world. This is super helpful!
Once you've completed the multi-block ritual, place down 4 (or more for future rituals) Sacrificial Bowls anywhere within 8 block horizontal radius from the center Sacrificial Bowl and use the required items on them. Once you place your Bound Book in the Golden Sacrificial Bowl, the ritual will start!
This is what the ritual will look like.
Tasks: Book of Binding: Foliot (Bound) Raw Iron Raw Gold Raw Copper Raw SilverRewards: 100 XP
Chalking It Up
Now that we have a Foliot Crusher, we can use politely ask it to crush down some End Stone, Obsidian and Calcite for us. We'll use these to make some new Chalk!
Tasks: Impure Yellow Chalk Impure Purple Chalk Impure Light Gray ChalkRewards: 100 XP
Red Chalk
R.I.P. Betsy
If we want to collect all of the Chalks, we'll need to summon and kill aa not-so friendly Afrit.
Even though this isn't a Possession Ritual, you'll need a live sacrifice for this ritual. In this instance, we'll be sacrificing a Cow. Sorry Betsy!
Tasks: Afrit Essence Impure Red ChalkRewards: Loot 50 XP
Empty Soul Gem
This item is used to capture mobs for transport or storage. It's also needed for the ATM Star.
Tasks: Soul GemRewards: Loot 100 XP
Tools of the Trade: Spectral Goggles
Quit eating that fruit!
There are more Otherworld items you will need to gather, and eating Demon's Dream Fruit every time you need the Third Eye effect gets annoying.
This is what the Otherworld Goggles are for! When equipped (even in your Curios slot), it gives the Third Eye effect!
Tasks: Otherworld GogglesRewards: Loot 100 XP
Iesnium: Ore of the Otherworld
The next step in your journey will be to find Iesnium Ore in the Nether.
Without the effects of the Third Eye, this will look just like Netherrack. Make sure to have your Otherworld Goggles equipped!
To locate the ore, try using a Divination Rod. You'll need to attune it to Netherrack first, then hold down right click to use it. After a few seconds, you will see a particle shoot out in the direction of the nearest Iesnium Ore. You can only mine the ore using the Infused Pickaxe!
Since you can't break this ore down into double the dusts using the standard methods, try using your Foliot Crusher to double your ingots per raw ore!
Note: If you don't see the particle, make sure your particle settings are turned on!
Tasks: Iesnium OreRewards: 100 XP
The Otherworld Pickaxe
Once you've gathered a few Raw Iesnium Ores, you'll probably want to use the first few ingots to make an Iesnium Pickaxe. This not only mines Iesnium like the Infused Pickaxe, but lasts a lot longer too.
Do yourself a favor and make one of these!
Tasks: Iesnium PickaxeRewards: Loot 100 XP
Demon Mining
With our ability to harvest Iesnium, we can call upon the Demons to do our bidding in the mines... I mean.... help us gather ores. Definitely not exploiting Demons or anything.
For this, we'll need to create a Dimensional Mineshaft to access the Demon Mining World. You'll also need a Mining Demon confined to a lamp, which you'll place inside of the Mineshaft for it to work. While any tier will complete this quest, higher tiers work faster and have a higher chance at mining Iesnium for you.
The Mineshafts do not auto-export on their own. You will need to extract the items out using either Hoppers, Transporting Demons, or some other method like Item Pipes. It will void any items over its storage limit.
Tasks: Dimensional Mineshaft Any Miners OresRewards: 100 XP
Demonir Magical Storage!
You're bound to have too many items playing this modpack. It's just it works, and if you haven't figured out your storage situation yet, Dimensional Storage might just be right for you!
To get started with this magical storage solution, you'll need to craft the Dimensional Storage Actuator and place it down into the world. This acts just like a Shulker Box, meaning if you break it, it won't lose any of the items stored inside.
By default, this has 128 storage slots with each slot holding up to 16 stacks of an item, except for items with NBT data. These will not stack and will take up an entire slot, so make sure to leave those items out!
If you aren't sure what items have NBT data on them, you can always check out the quest "NBT and You" in the Storage questline for more info on NBT!
Tasks: Storage Actuator Base Dimensional Storage Actuator Dimensional Crystal MatrixRewards: Loot 100 XP
Upgrading Our Magical Storage
To upgrade the amount of stacks your magical storage can hold, you'll need to make Storage Stabilizers.
Once made, these must point directly at the Dimensional Matrix part of your Storage Actuator, not the base. These can be up to 5 blocks away, but must have a clear line of sight to the Matrix.
Whenever you want to upgrade to a higher tier Stabilizer, breaking it won't destroy the items inside. However, you will not be able to add any more items to your storage until it is either replaced or upgraded.
Below is an example of a simple setup!
Tasks: Smart FilterRewards: Loot 100 XP
Tools of the Trade: Divination Rod
Hunting for &dOtherworld&r Materials
While you can get most of the Otherworld materials using Spiritfire, you can also use Divination Rods to locate these materials.
First, you'll need to attune the Rod to the material you are looking for. For example, if you are on the hunt for Otherstone, you can use the Rod on Andesite to help locate the Otherstone in the world.
Once attuned to a material, you can hold right click with the Rod in hand, and a particle will shoot off in the direction of the nearest material it is attuned to.
You will still need to be under the effects of the Third Eye to be able to harvest the Otherworld block.
Tasks: Divination RodRewards: 10 XP
Remote Access
Want to access your storage remotely? This can be done with either the Stable Wormhole or the Storage Accessor.
To use the Stable Wormhole, shift-click a Storage Actuator to link it. You can then place the Wormhole to act as another storage location.
The Storage Accessor is linked in the same way, but acts as a wireless remote that can even work across dimensions!
Tasks: Stable Wormhole Storage AccessorRewards: Loot 100 XP
Familiars
Occultism provides more than just Demons to crush your ores!
There are Demons that can move stuff for you, chop down wood, and more!!
There are also ways to summon cool friends known as Familiars that give special buffs and even fight for you! Make sure to check out the Familiar Rituals in your guide book!
Tasks: Manual check-offRewards: 10 XP

Tasks: Manual check-off Manual check-off
Eziveus' Spectral Compulsion
Put some Demon Dust™ on it!
Our next step is a foray into Infusion Rituals. These rituals are used to imbue items with the magic of demons.
The first tier of Infusion Rituals is Eziveus' Spectral Compulsion. We'll be using this ritual to create several items that you'll need throughout this mod.
It is recommended to create this ritual in a separate area from your first one, because the three main types of rituals build off each previous tier.
Tasks: Experience Bottle ×2 Any Dusts EmeraldRewards: 25 XP
Tools of the Trade: Butcher's Knife
Hack and slash!
Tasks: Butcher Knife
Lime Chalk
The first and most important item to make using Eziveus' Spectral Compulsion is the Research Fragment Dust. This is used in combination with some crushed Emeralds to create Lime Chalk!
Tasks: Research Fragment Dust Impure Lime ChalkRewards: Loot 50 XP
Ihagan's Enthrallment
Who you gonna call?
With Lime Chalk, it's time to delve into Possesion Rituals. These rituals are slightly different from the others because they all require a live sacrifice, usually small mobs such as Chickens, Bees, Bats, etc. However, as rituals get more complicated, they will require larger and larger sacrifices.
Even if you've placed all of the items needed and the Book of Binding into the Golden Sacrificial Bowl, the Ritual will not begin until you kill the sacrifice on top of the runes.
It is recommended that you make some sort of mob capture item such as an Empty Soul Gem, Jar, Mob Imprisonment Tool, or Quantum Catcher!
The first tier of Possession rituals is Heidryn's Lure, which is only used to get mundane items like Skeleton Skulls and End Stone. Because of this, you can skip straight to the second tier of ritual, Ihagan's Enthrallment.
Tasks: Honey Block Honeycomb Block Honeycomb Honey BottleRewards: 25 XP
Orange Chalk
Using Ihagan's Enthrallment, you can sacrifice an Allay, Bat, Bee, or Parrot to summon a Possessed Bee. Upon defeating one, it will drop Cursed Honey, the main ingredient for making Orange Chalk!
Tasks: Cursed Honey Impure Orange Chalk
Abras' Open Conjure
Hot Demons!
No, not that kind.
Afrit Demons are Demons of Fire. They are more advanced Demons, which some are friends and some are... not. It all depends on how strongly the ritual can control the Afrit.
Because we don't have access to Red Chalk yet, all we can summon is an Unbound Demon, meaning it cannot be controlled and will be violent.
Tasks: Any All Nether Quartz Gunpowder Netherrack Flint And SteelRewards: 25 XP
Strigeor's Higher Binding
The "Everything" Ritual
Strigeor's Higher Binding is the second tier of Infusion Rituals. It's used for many different things, but the main things we'll need are the Infused Pickaxe and Gray Paste.
Tasks: Phantom Membrane Gunpowder Gray Dye Clay BallRewards: 25 XP
Gray Chalk
Using Strigeor's Higher Binding, you can create Gray Paste. Smear this on a piece of Impure White Chalk to create Gray Chalk.
Tasks: Gray Paste Impure Gray ChalkRewards: Loot 50 XP
Green Chalk
Using Eziveus' Spectral Compulsion, we can imbue a myriad of different nature blocks to form some Nature Paste. Combine this Paste with some Impure White Chalk to create Green Chalk.
Tasks: Nature Paste Impure Green ChalkRewards: Loot 50 XP
Tools of the Trade: Infused Pickaxe
Most of the items we've needed from the Otherworld so far just needed some Spiritfire. However, we will need to use the help of the Third Eye to find the Ore of the Otherworld.
We'll also need a special pickaxe to be able to mine it. For this, we'll need to Infuse a Demon into a Spirit Attuned Pickaxe Head to create a pickaxe that can break this new kind of ore.
Tasks: Infused PickaxeRewards: Loot 50 XP
Tools of the Trade: Ritual Satchel
Pocket Ritual!
Tired of lugging around Chalks, Candles, Skulls, and Crystals? Just make a Ritual Satchel!
By sneak + right-clicking with the Ritual Satchel in your hand, you can fill it with all the materials you need to draw a ritual circle.
Once you've loaded up the Satchel, simply right-click any preview block to begin (slowly) automatically placing all the runes for the selected ritual.
If a piece of chalk inside the bag falls under 40% durability, the enchantment glint on this item will dissapear to signal that it may be time to repair or replace some of your Chalks.
Tasks: Apprentice Ritual SatchelRewards: 75 XP
Chalk Repair
You break it, &mwe&r Demons fix it!
If you haven't noticed already, making and re-making rituals over and over again is very taxing on the durability of your Chalks.
If you're worried about your Chalk breaking, but don't feel like doing the entire ritual to create a new chalk over again, then this ritual is for you!
Using the power of a Dijinni, you can repair any color of Chalk to it's maximum!
Alternatively, you could use something like the Eternal Stella from the Forbidden Arcanus mod to permenantly preserve your Chalks!
Tasks: Manual check-off
Sevira's Permanent Confinement
The "Even More Everything" Ritual
Sevira's Permanent Confinement is the third tier of Infusion Rituals. It's mainly used to create the next level of foundation Chalk, Black Chalk.
It's also used to create a couple of items that can speed up ritual making and performing by a significant amount.
Tasks: Wither Rose ×3 Any Dusts Netherite Crushed Blackstone ×2Rewards: 25 XP
Black Chalk
Using Sevira's Permanent Confinement, we can combine several different Wither materials and some Netherite to create three Witherite Dust. With these, we can create ourselfs the highest form of Foundation Chalk, Black Chalk.
Tasks: Witherite Dust Impure Black ChalkRewards: Loot 50 XP
Tools of the Trade: Artisanal Ritual Satchel
The Ritual Satchel is nice, but it takes a long time to place all the blocks. Now that you can perform the Sevira's Permenant Confinement ritual, you can create the Artisanal Ritual Satchel!
The Artisanal Ritual Satchel functions nearly identically to the regular Ritual Satchel, except it instantly places all the nessecary items for the ritual, and has the added ability to right-click on Golden Bowl to erase all the Chalk Runes and collect all the other items (Skulls, Candles, and Crystals) and return them to the Satchel.
No, it doesn't restore the durability of the Chalk.
Tasks: Artisanal Ritual SatchelRewards: 100 XP
Repairing Items
Free(ish) durability!
Similar to the Chalk Repairing function of Strigeor's Higher Binding, Sevira's Permanent Confinement can be used to repair items using the power of an Afrit Demon.
This ritual can repair just about anything, so Demon Miners, tools, and armor can all be restored to their original durability!
All items that are repaired using this ritual retain their original properties (affixes, enchantments, etc), so don't worry about your precious enchantments!
Tasks: Manual check-off
Abras' Open Commanding Conjure
How... Fleshy...
Abras' Open Commanding Conjure is used to bring an Afrit demon into a Pig. Because this ritual is performed without the use of Red Chalk, it's only powerful enough to summon an unbound demon.
In particular, this ritual will create an Afrit-possessed Zombified Piglin, which will drop some Demonic Meat, which is used to craft Pink Chalk
WARNING: YOU MAY HAVE TO DO THIS ONE MULTIPLE TIMES TO GET ENOUGH DEMONIC MEAT.
Tasks: Cherry Leaves Pink Petals Tallow QuartzRewards: 25 XP
Pink Chalk
After fighting through a few Demon Possessed Zombified Piglins summoned by Abras' Open Commanding Conjure, you can use the Demonic Meat dropped by them to craft some Pink Chalk.
Tasks: Demonic Meat ×3 Impure Pink ChalkRewards: Loot 50 XP
Osorin's Unbound Calling
For the less trial-chamber-inclined of us
Osorin's Unbound Calling is the second tier of Demon-less rituals. The first tier isn't useful for progression at all, it's only used for reviving Familiars and turning Vexes into Allays.
This ritual is used to create a ton of rare-ish blocks, items, and materials that you might not be able to (or it's hard to) get otherwise.
Tasks: Manual check-off
Abras' Fortified Conjure
Is it a Bird? Is it a Plane? No, it's an unbound &9Marid&r!
Don't worry, this is the last of the Abras series of rituals. It is used to summon a Marid demon, but even though it uses Red Chalk, it's not powerful enough to bind the Demon. This means that, unfortunately, you're going to have to fight it.
This ritual uses a Trident as a sacrifice, which is confusing because most sacrifices are living creatures. So instead of killing a mob on top of the completed ritual circle, you simply throw the Trident at the center bowl to start the ritual.
Tasks: Prismarine Crystals Prismarine Shard Ghast Tear Conduit TridentRewards: 50 XP
Blue Chalk
After you've successfully slain the Unbound Marid Demon that you summoned with Abras' Fortified Conjure, you can use the Marid Essence that it drops to craft the "highest" colored Chalk, Blue Chalk.
Tasks: Marid Essence Impure Blue ChalkRewards: Loot 50 XP
Fatma's Incentivized Attraction
Maximum Summon
That first Foliot Crusher was cool, but what if I told you that you could summon a demon that gives you 6 dusts per raw ore it crushes?
The Marid Crusher does exactly that. To summon one, you'll need to use Fatma's Incentivized Attraction.
Tasks: Diamond Block Emerald Block Block of Iesnium Ghast TearRewards: 50 XP
Xeovrenth Adjure
Maximum Possession
Xeovrenth Adjure is the maximum tier of Possession Rituals. It only has two uses: creating Cruelty Essence, the main ingredient in Brown Chalk, and creating an Iesnium Golem, which is basically just an Iron Golem that's immortal and does more damage.
Tasks: Armadillo Scute ×4 Rabbit Foot ×4 Pointed Dripstone ×2 Any Wools ×2Rewards: 50 XP
Uphyxes' Inverted Tower
Maximum Infusion
Uphyxes' Inverted Tower is the maximum tier of Infusion Rituals. It doesn't have as many uses as the other three tiers, but it's still nessecary for the "endgame" of Occultism.
Mainly, it's used to create Dragonyst Dust, which is the main ingredient for Magenta Chalk.
Tasks: Dragon Breath ×3 Amethyst Dust ×2 Crushed End Stone End Crystal ×4Rewards: 50 XP
Light Blue Chalk
After using Fatma's Incentivized Attraction to summon a Marid Crusher, you can turn Ice, Packed Ice, and Blue Ice into their crushed forms, and use these to create Light Blue Chalk.
Tasks: Crushed Ice Crushed Packed Ice Crushed Blue Ice Impure Light Blue ChalkRewards: Loot 50 XP
&#AD00C8Magenta Chalk
To create Dragonyst Dust, you'll need to perform Uphyxes' Inverted Tower. However, to create Magenta Chalk, you'll also need some materials that you can only get through the Marid Crusher.
Tasks: Dragonyst Dust Impure Magenta Chalk
Cyan Chalk
With your freshly summoned Marid Crusher, you can break down an Echo Shard and an Iesnium Ingot, which when combined with a Glow Ink Sac creates Cyan Chalk.
Tasks: Echo Dust Impure Cyan Chalk
&#4E2C00Brown Chalk
After slaying the Goat of Mercy summoned from Xeovrenth Adjure, you'll find yourself one Cruelty Essence richer. Combine this with some Cocao Beans to create Brown Chalk.
Tasks: Cruelty Essence Impure Brown Chalk
Ronaza's Contact
With this sacred treasure I summon...
Once you've gathered every single colored Chalk and Foundation Chalk, you can perform the second Demon-less type ritual, Ronaza's Contact. This is the ultimate ritual, using everything you've learned so far!
It has limited uses, but everything created with this ritual is super powerful!
Tasks: Impure White Chalk Impure Light Gray Chalk Impure Gray Chalk Impure Black Chalk Impure Brown Chalk Impure Red Chalk Impure Orange Chalk Impure Yellow Chalk Impure Lime Chalk Impure Green Chalk Impure Green Chalk Impure Cyan Chalk Impure Light Blue Chalk Impure Blue Chalk Impure Purple Chalk Impure Magenta Chalk Impure Pink ChalkRewards: Loot 1 XP levels
Rainbow Chalk
Grab your chalks, draw your Ronaza's Contact ritual, and get ready to create the ULTIMATE CHALK!
Instead of having to lug around a full set of 16 chalks, you can use the Rainbow Chalk to paint a color-changing Rune that counts as any of them!
Tasks: Rainbow ChalkRewards: Loot 1 XP levels
Void Chalk
An "upgrade" to the Rainbow Chalk, for those who don't like the rapid color-switching runes ruining their tediously crafted aesthetic.
Has the same function as the Rainbow Chalk, except all the runes will show up as white.
Tasks: Void Chalk
Iesnium Anvil
Arguably the most useful item that you can create in Occultism, the Iesnium Anvil is a super-powerful version of the Vanilla Anvil.
Created using Uphyxes' Inverted Tower, it:
- Is unbreakable. - Increases the maximum level of all enchants for anything combined on it by one level. - Costs half as much xp as the estimate says (rounded down, so if it says 25, it'll cost 12). - Has a smaller experience requirement increase for repeated edits on the same item. - Increases the maximum xp level at which you can edit items (the point at which it says "Too Expensive!").
Tasks: Iesnium Anvil
Iesnium Ritual Bowl
Super-speed Rituals!
As you've probably noticed, rituals tend to be... a little slow. But not anymore! Using Sevira's Permanent Confinement, you can create the Iesnium Ritual Bowl.
When using this in place of a Golden Ritual Bowl, it greatly reduces how long it takes to perform a ritual, taking it down to one fourth of its original time!
Tasks: Iesnium Ritual BowlRewards: 100 XP
Trinity Gem
Using Ronaza's Contact, you can upgrade your Soul Gem to create a Trinity Gem. It's basically just a beefed up version of the Soul Gem that can capture larger enemies, although it still can't contain most bosses.
Tasks: Trinity Gem
Eldritch Chalice
With Ronaza's Contact, you can upgrade your Iesnium Sacrificial Bowl to the Eldritch Chalice. When used in a ritual, reduces the time it takes to complete... entirely.
Yes, the Eldritch Chalice makes it so that all rituals complete instantly!
Tasks: Eldritch Chalice
What's Next?
Now that you've come this far, you may be asking yourself, what's next? Well, there are so many more things to explore in Occultism!
You can see a comprehensive list of every single ritual and item in your Dictionary of Spirits, you could try going through all the rituals' outcomes to see if you can find something that piques your interest!
If you haven't already, you could lay out and decorate three separate ritual areas, one for Summons, one for Possessions, and one for Infusions.
There's always new ways to use each and every seemingly mundane feature to maximize your experience with the modpack. Happy ritual crafting!
Tasks: Manual check-offRewards: 1 XP levels
The Basics of Rituals
This is the main source of information on Rituals. Here's the basics:
Tiers of Rituals:
Rituals have (basically) four tiers based on how powerful the Demon that you're invoking is. The first tier is Foliot, then Dijini, Afrit, and Marid. Some rituals fall into in-between tiers, such as the Unbound Afrit tier.
Types of Rituals:
There are five main types of rituals, but we'll only need four for progression. The main three are Summoning Rituals, Possession Rituals, and Infusion Rituals. Each one will be explained the first time that they appear in these quests. The fourth type of ritual is a sort of Demon-less Ritual, meaning that it uses bits and pieces from all three types to preform a special action without the direct usage of a Demon.
The fifth type, Familiar Rituals, are not needed for progression. But they can still be summon some useful friends to help you out!
Chalks:
There are two types of Chalks: Foundation Chalks, and Colored Chalks.
Foundation chalks are used in every single ritual, and each tier higher gets a shade darker, starting with White Chalk and ending with Black Chalk.
Colored Chalks are the most commonly used, but the color of the Chalk doesn't directly corelate to its power the same as Foundation Chalks.
Tasks: Manual check-off

Can be used as Reactor Coolant
Easy item to automate infinite water.
Need more water? Make another!

Honey I Shrunk Myself

Complete all the tips!

Quest
And Other Useful Items!
On this page, you'll find some useful items and info to help you on your journey!
Tasks: Manual check-offRewards: 10 XP
Compasses for Searching
Helps Find Biomes/Structures
The Nature's Compass gives you a list of biomes you can search for.
Select a biome, then hit 'Search.' You'll see some info in the top left, and the compass will point in the direction of the biome.
The Explorer's Compass works the same but works for structures, instead of biomes.
Tasks: Smart FilterRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Crafting... on a Stick!
Less Placing, more Crafting
Need a portable Crafting Table? How about a portable Smithing Table?
Crafting On A Stick adds portable versions of some of your favorite crafting stations! This is a must have in the early game.
Tasks: Smart FilterRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Easy Villagers
Villagers, made easy
In Vanilla, Villagers can be really frustrating to deal with. Cycling trades is not easy at all, and professions can sometimes be tough to deal with.
Easy Villagers is a mod to make all of it much easier to deal with! For starters, you can pick up a villager by sneak-right clicking them. They can then be easily placed in the world, or in specific blocks from the Easy Villager mod!
You can search @EasyVillagers in JEI to see blocks the mod offers!

Smart Filter
No more Annoying Traders!
Trapped Trader Carpets will kill any Wandering Traders that spawn near it instantly!
These might be the best items in the entire pack.
Tasks: Smart FilterRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Simple Magnets
Don't you hate when your breaking something and the Blocks fall just out of your reach!
Well worry no more for we have Magnets! Simply Right Click while holding the Magnet to turn it on. Then, all dropped Items and Blocks in a 5 Block Radius will come to you.
You can also equip the Magnet in your Curios to keep using it!
If you don't wish to continue using the Magnet (I find this happens near Mob Farms) then just Right Click with it again to disable it.
It can also be upgraded to increase the range!
Tasks: BasicmagnetRewards: Random loot roll 10 XP
Ranged Pump
The Ranged Pump is so special it gets its own Mod!
The Pump will collect Water Sources beneath it and replace them with Stone. It does need Energy to work though, but it's worth it, it has a huge range!
The Water collected in it will need to be Piped out.

text.v: Here you'll find all of the rewards you can get by slaying enemies.
The Ender Dragon is the Boss that guards The End.
When you enter an End Portal you'll arrive at the End Island where she spawns.
She has 200 Hearts and can attack with Fireballs or ramming into you.
You'll have to break the End Crystals on the pillars as they heal her, in order to kill her!
Once you do kill her, she'll drop: Arcane Essence, Epic Shaderbags, Dragonskin, Dragon Scales from two different mods, and a bunch of experience!
Then the Portal will open up so you can return to the Overworld, or you can find an End Gateway to explore the outer islands. You'll also find a Dragon Egg on the Portal.
The Wither is the second Minecraft Boss, this one being more elective.
You'll have to build the Wither to spawn him in. Using 4 Soul Sand in a T shape and placing 3 Wither Skeleton Skulls on top will spawn him in!
He has 300 Hearts and will fly around shooting Wither Skulls at Players or Mobs.
When taken to half Health he will gain a shield against Projectiles and will need to be killed with a Sword or Axe.
Once you kill him he'll drop: Nether Star, chance at a Withering Soul, and a ton of Corail Items.

title.v: Kill The Trader Villager and His Annoying Llamas

text.v: While making a lot of the questlines for ATM7, the Trader Villager thought it'd be funny to constantly push me around in the quest screen.
The Warden is a boss added in 1.20.
He spawns by having 3 naturally spawning Sculk Shriekers going off in a row, or any Shriekers going off after a first Warden has spawned.
He is the most powerful Mob added by Minecraft, with 500 Hearts and over 20 Hearts damage with his attacks.
His attacks include hitting you and Sonar Blasts for those farther.
His only weakness is being blind, but like daredevil it just made his other senses much stronger! If you are close he can smell you and careful with making noise!
If you somehow kill him he will drop: Sculk Catalysts, Warden Carapace, and Heart of the Deep.

title.v: Welcome to All The Mods 10 - LITE!

text.v: ATM10 is a kitchensink pack that allows you to explore the world of modded Minecraft in your own way!
This modpack is a version of ATM10 built to have a similar experience as the main pack, while also focusing heavily on performance, so it can be run on lower-end systems.
If you have any questions or issues, feel free to join the ATM discord!
In this modpack, quests are optional. Mods are not gated behind completing any quests!
A lot of the individual questlines outside of the Main questline are meant to serve as mod guides. If you want to follow the progression, make sure to check out the Main Questline!
